items.name: Abacus
items.description: A basic wooden abacus, designed for merchants and treasurers. It comes with a simple latched case to protect the counting beads from damage.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Acid (Vial)
items.description: A round glass container filled with a clear liquid. It has a paper label indicating in common that it contains acid, and to warning not to accidentally break the glass.
items.properties: See PHB page 148.
items.author: PHB

items.name: Alchemist's Fire
items.properties: This sticky, adhesive fluid ignites when exposed to air. As an action, you can throw this flask up to 20 feet, shattering it on impact. Make a ranged attack against a creature or object, treating the alchemist's fire as an improvised weapon. On a hit, the target takes 1d4 fire damage at the start of each of its turns. A creature can end this damage by using its action to make a DC 10 Dexterity check to extinguish the flames.
items.author: PHB

items.name: Ammo Belt
items.description: This shoulder belt is ideally suited for holding sling bullets, darts, arrows or bolts.
items.properties: More reliable than a quiver.
items.author: Baldur's Gate II

items.name: Bedroll
items.description: A sheepskin bedroll.
items.author: PHB

items.name: Blanket
items.description: A thick woolen blanket. Something like this is perfect for wrapping up during those long cold nights spent staring at a cave wall.
items.author: PHB

items.name: Candle
items.description: Six red wax candles.
items.properties: For 1 hour, a candle sheds bright light in a 5-foot radius and dim light for an additional 5 feet.
items.author: PHB

items.name: Crowbar
items.description: Using a crowbar grants advantage to Strength checks where the crowbar’s leverage can be applied.
items.author: PHB

items.name: Exploding Gold Coins
items.description: Exploding gold coins (Looks legit. Should avoid contact with real gold coins for safety...)

items.name: Fishing Tackle
items.description: Useful for catching fish.
items.author: PHB

items.name: Hammer
items.description: A crosspeen hammer forged from steel. It has a gently crowned flat face that has been hardened and tempered for toughness. The handle is hand carved ash, flame treated and oiled.
items.author: PHB

items.name: Holy Symbol
items.description: A wooden holy symbol.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Lantern
items.description: A slightly rusty old lantern with a glass casing.
items.properties:
A Lantern provides bright light within a radius of 10 squares.
The light lasts 8 hours per pint of oil.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Marbles
items.description: A handful of marbles in a small cloth bag. Equal to playing marbles is scattering them across the floor in an effort to trip your enemies.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Oil
items.description: A flask of oil suitable for use in a lantern.
items.properties: Enough to last for 48 hours. As an action, you can splash the oil in this flask onto a creature within 5 feet of you or throw it up to 20 feet, shattering it on impact. Make a ranged attack against a target creature or object, treating the oil as an improvised weapon. On a hit, the target is covered in oil. If the target takes any fire damage before the oil dries (after 1 minute), the target takes an additional 5 fire damage from the burning oil. You can also pour a flask of oil on the ground to cover a 5-foot-square area, provided that the surface is level. If lit, the oil burns for 2 rounds and deals 5 fire damage to any creature that enters the area or ends its turn in the area. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Old Pouch
items.description: An old pouch. Works as any pouch might, but it has a hole in it.
items.properties: Every day, player loses 1d4 of any small object stored in the pouch.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Pouch
items.description: A cloth or leather pouch that can hold up to 20 sling bullets or 50 blowgun needles, among other things.
items.author: PHB

items.name: Rope
items.description: 100 feet of rope, coiled neatly.
items.properties:
As a Utilize action, you can tie a knot with Rope if you succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check. The Rope can be burst with a successful DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check.

You can bind an unwilling creature with the Rope only if the creature has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition. If the creature’s legs are bound, the creature has the Restrained condition until it escapes. Escaping the Rope requires the creature to make a successful DC 15 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check as an action,
items.author: DMG

items.name: Satchel
items.description: A thick leather satchel containing an adventurer's’ kit: 6 wax candles, two pieces of white chalk, two pieces of red chalk, a small bag of (100) clay marbles, a whistle, four pieces of charcoal, three large sacks, six iron pitons, a hammer, a tinderbox with flint and steel, 2 empty copper vials, a chunk of coal, and three large sheets of paper.

items.name: Sharpening Stone
items.description: A high quality sharpening stone

items.name: Skeleton Key Chain
items.description: Key chain with multiple types of ‘skeleton keys’

items.name: Sledge Hammer
items.description: This large sledge hammer has been cast entirely out of steel. There is a small symbol of a rat moulded into the hammer head, above Dwarvish lettering that indicates the weight.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Smuggler's Boots
items.description: Smugglers boots – great for hiding a concealed backup dagger or wand

items.name: Smuggler's Coat
items.description: A hooded cloak with a dozen inside pockets.

items.name: Stabby String
items.description: A popular Goblin trap; a 50 ft length of neatly coiled wire that has nails welded onto it at regular intervals. The resulting product can be used either by running it across the floor or by intertwining it along a fence or wall.
items.properties: Stabby String can be left semi-coiled on the floor, at half it's length, to create difficult terrain. Any creature that attempts to pass over the Stabby String is subject to 1d4 piercing damage.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Torch
items.description: A short stick with oil-soaked cloth wrapped around one end so it can burn as a torch.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Used Whetstone
items.description: An old whetstone and a half-used vial of oil. The stone itself is ever-so-slightly worn into a curve from years of use, but it will be decades before it's wear renders it useless.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Vial of Antitoxin
items.description: A creature that drinks this vial of liquid gains advantage on saving throws against poison for 1 hour. It confers no benefit to undead or constructs.
items.author: PHB

items.name: Wand Chamber
items.description: Wand Chamber – fashioned to look like a scroll case, it contains 1d12 slots to hold wands – think of it as a circular bandolier for your everyday wizard

items.name: Waterskin
items.description: A waterskin made from a sheep's bladder.
items.author: PHB

items.name: Zoltar's Pearlescent Ring
items.description: A simple white pearlescent ring. Curse: Lose 1d4 max health once per day. The effect stacks each day. Once worn, this ring cannot be removed. Any attempt to remove the ring sees it reappear after a few seconds. Any attempt to circumvent the curse by removing the ring finger sees it appear on a different finger. If the wearer removes every finger, the curse ends. Should they fail to get the curse removed before their health falls below 0 they become an undead thrall.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Adamantine Armor
items.description: This suit of armor is reinforced with adamantine, one of the hardest substances in existence. While you're wearing it, any critical hit against you becomes a normal hit.
items.properties: Medium, Heavy (Not Hide)
items.author: DMG

items.name: Adventurer's Robe
items.description: This robe has been specially enchanted to meet the eclectic needs of the adventuring mage. Aside from protecting the wearer from various forms of crushing damage, it also provides protection from the basilisk's petrying gaze and polymorphing powers of rival mages. As with other such robes, the Adventurer's Robe can only be worn by those engaged in the wizardly profession.
items.properties:
AC: 11 + Dex Modifier
Disadvantage on Stealth
+ 1 bonus vs. petrification & polymorph
items.author: Baldur's Gate II

items.name: Aeger's Hide
items.description: This heavy and thick bear hide is all that remains of the fabled Aeger. Several hundred years ago, the Aeger, a giant bear, terrorized hundreds of small villages up and down the Sword Coast. The bear was invulnerable to fire, cold, or acid. Finally the young men and women of several villages banded together, forming a militia almost two hundred people strong. The Aeger was surrounded and finally slain. Less than a dozen villagers survived, and they carved the Aeger's hide amongst themselves. Out of one of the pieces this armor was created.
items.properties:
Medium Armor
Armor Class: 12 + Dex Modifier (max 2)
Provides +15% resistance to fire, cold, and acid
Render's it's wearer immune to confusion
items.author: Baldur's Gate II

items.name: Animated Shield
items.properties: While holding this shield, you can speak its command word as a bonus action to cause it to animate. The shield leaps into the air and hovers in your space to protect you as if you were wielding it, leaving your hands free. The shield remains animated for 1 minute, until you use a bonus action to end this effect, or until you are incapacitated or die, at which point the shield falls to the ground or into your hand if you have one free.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Armor +1
items.description: You have a +1 bonus to AC while wearing this armor.
items.properties: Light, Medium or Heavy
items.author: DMG

items.name: Armor +2
items.description: You have a +2 bonus to AC while wearing this armor.
items.properties: Light, Medium or Heavy
items.author: DMG

items.name: Armor +3
items.description: You have a +3 bonus to AC while wearing this armor.
items.properties: Light, Medium or Heavy
items.author: DMG

items.name: Armor of Barbarian Rage
items.description: This is a set of Studded Leather Armour that has been enchanted with the spirit of a long dead barbarian warrior. Once per day it allows the user to channel it's rageful spirit.
items.properties:
Light Armor (AC is 14+DEX mod) - Once per day the user can use Barbarian Rage during this rage:
You have advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. When you make a melee weapon attack using Strength, you gain a bonus to the damage roll that increases as you gain levels, counting your own level as the levels you would have in barbarian, as shown in the Rage Damage column of the Barbarian table. You have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. You cannot cast any spells while in the rage and any concentration spells being maintained when you enter rage instantly fade. This effect lasts for 1 minute, or dissipates if you do not deal physical or take any type of damage in a turn.
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Armor of Invulnerability
items.description: You have resistance to nonmagical damage while you wear this armor. Additionally, you can use an action to make yourself immune to nonmagical damage for 10 minutes or until you are no longer wearing the armor. Once this special action is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
items.properties: Plate Armor
items.author: DMG

items.name: Armor of Resistance
items.description: You have resistance to one type of damage while you wear this armor. The DM chooses the type or determines it randomly from the options below.
items.properties: Light, Medium or Heavy
items.author: DMG

items.name: Armor of Vulnerability
items.description: While wearing this armor, you have resistance to one of the following damage types: bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing. The DM chooses the type or determines it randomly. Curse. This armor is cursed, a fact that is revealed only when an identify spell is cast on the armor or you attune to it. Attuning to the armor curses you until you are targeted by the remove curse spell or similar magic: removing the armor fails to end the curse. While cursed you have vulnerability to two of the three damage type associated with the armor (not the one to which it grants resistance).
items.properties: Plate Armor
items.author: DMG

items.name: Arrow-catching Shield
items.properties:
Wielding a shield increases your Armor Class by 2. You can benefit from only one shield at a time.

This shield provides an additional +2 bonus to Armor Class against ranged attacks.

In addition, whenever an attacked makes a ranged attack against a target within 5 feet of the wielder, they may use their reaction to become the target instead.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Boots of Feral Leaping
items.description: Plain leather boots, tattered and worn, but glistening with a soft white light similar to the sunlight reflecting off freshly fallen snow.
items.properties: When you wear these boots you can instill your leaps with incredible bursts of power. As a bonus action, you can attempt to leap. Make a DC16 Strength check: if you are successful, you can leap either 15 feet vertically or 20 feet horizontally. On a failure, you are knocked prone where you stand.
items.author: /u/gimme_some_sunshine via Matt Mercer

items.name: Bound Armor of the Demon
items.description: Gives insane buffs, will eventually turn you into one of whatever it's namesake is.
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Bound Armor of the Fey
items.description: Gives insane buffs, will eventually turn you into one of whatever it's namesake is.
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Bound Armor of the Lich
items.description: Gives insane buffs, will eventually turn you into one of whatever it's namesake is.
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Breastplate Armor
items.description: This armor consists of a fitted metal chest piece worn with supple leather. Although it leaves the legs and arms relatively unprotected, this armor provides good protection for the wearer's vital organs while leaving the wearer relatively unencumbered.
items.properties:
Medium Armor
Armor Class: 14 + Dex Modifier (max 2)
items.author: SRD

items.name: Bronze Tower Shield
items.description: A tower shield of bronze, cast into the likeness of a chimera’s heads and enameled to provide the appropriate colors.
items.properties:
Wielding this shield increases your Armor Class by 3. You can benefit from only one shield at a time.
Disadvantage on Stealth
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Buckler of Friendship
items.description: This buckler has been enchanted with the power to protect you and your allies.
items.properties: For one round, all allies gain +1 AC.

items.name: Buzzing Buckler
items.description: A wooden buckler with a burned-in sigil of a bee on the shield face. It vibrates ferociously when struck.
items.properties: Adds no armor. If you are the victim of a ranged attacked, you may use your reaction to increase your AC by +1. If you choose to do this, and the attack fails to hit you, the projectile is deflected by your shield, and bursts into a cloud of angry bees that will seek the attacker and sting it relentlessly, causing 1d6 poison damage at the beginning of each of their turns for one minute, or until you recall the bees. The victim also suffers disadvantage on attack rolls and can no longer maintain concentration.
items.author: /u/gimme_some_sunshine

items.name: Chain Mail Armor
items.description: Made of interlocking metal rings, chain mail includes a layer of quilted fabric worn underneath the mail to prevent chafing and to cushion the impact of blows. The suit includes gauntlets.
items.properties:
Heavy Armor
Armour Class: 16
Disadvantage on Stealth
items.author: SRD

items.name: Chain Shirt Armor
items.description: Made of interlocking metal rings, a chain shirt is worn between layers of clothing or leather. This armor offers modest protection to the wearer's upper body and allows the sound of the rings rubbing against one another to be muffled by outer layers.
items.properties:
Medium Armor
Armor Class: 13 + Dex Modifier (max 2)
items.author: SRD

items.name: Cinder Glove
items.description: A left-handed glove. It remains warm regardless of atmosphere, and is almost painfully hot to be touched with.
items.properties: Rubbing the fingertips of this glove together creates flames that can ignite easily flammable objects. Holding a creature with it causes painful burns that will blister the skin, and unarmed strikes with this glove deal an additional 1 fire damage.
items.author: /u/gimme_some_sunshine

items.name: Cloak of Partial Shadow
items.description: A normal looking black cloak with a high collar. When activated it gives off small puffs of black smoke that help obscure the wearer.
items.properties: Speak the command word to activate the cloak and receive advantage on your next stealth roll. The wearer can only benefit from the effect once. It lasts for up to 6 seconds.
items.author: AdamLapka

items.name: Crescent Armor Spikes
items.description: A set of Armor Spikes made out of thick, sharp silver. They can be attached to full or half-plate, and behave like normal armor spikes. However, they grow faintly in total darkness - - enough for the wearer to see 5 ft, or for another person to see the wearer from up to 50 ft away.
items.author: /u/LittleDizzleDaGusha

items.name: Dead Man's Plate
items.description: A suit of plate armor, worn by the skeletal remains of a long-dead warrior. The metal still glistens as if it had been polished yesterday. On inspection, the name of seemingly every warrior to ever don the armor has been inscribed upon the front and back of the chest plate, covering nearly every inch of its surface with precisely written, black runes. There remains room for one last name.
items.properties:
Heavy Armor
Armour Class: 18
Disadvantage on Stealth
items.author: Unknown

items.name: Decrepit Skeleton in Armor
items.description: The skeletal remains of a long-dead warrior, wearing a suit of plate armor which has long since tarnished. The name of every warrior to ever die by the last wearer’s hand has been inscribed upon the front and back of the chest plate, covering nearly every inch of its surface with chaotically written, black runes.

items.name: Dragon Head Shield
items.description: A large copper shield, embossed with a copper dragon’s head. “Elvalynte” is inscribed on the interior in a flowing script. (34gp)

items.name: Eternity Armor
items.description:
Nigh-unbreakable golemsteel armor enchanted to withstand nearly any strike.
If a ranged attack targets a friendly creature besides yourself within five feet radius, you can move them and take the shot to negate the damage and effects instead; if they are within a 10 feet radius, use your reaction.
items.properties: Heavy Armor | AC 20 | Str 20 | Stealth: Disadvantage
items.author: u/giratina2648

items.name: Flask Belt
items.description: Utility belt of flasks

items.name: Flesh Shield
items.description: A small wooden shield bound in human skin bearing a tattoo that appears to be some sort of map. The skin is held in place with a rim of beaten copper.
items.properties: Wielding this shield increases your Armor Class by 1. You can benefit from only one shield at a time.
items.author: Unknown

items.name: Gauntlets
items.description: The curse of the gauntlets was that no magic would ever help you, beneficial or baneful and anything you were in contact with would lose its magical properties while you're touching it. found out the contact one when visiting flying mage's tower. I was no longer welcome there, but with certain classes the gloves are pretty sweet even considering the downside. Oh also the curse had a very specific trigger, the gauntlets could only be removed if you cast remove curse on them and then had a chaotic neutral halfling pull them off of you with the intention of stealing them. even if you hacked your arms off and then had regeneration cast on you your hands would grow back with the gauntlets on them.

items.name: Half Plate Armor
items.description: Half plate consists of shaped metal plates that cover most of the wearer's body. It does not include leg protection beyond simple greaves that are attached with leather straps.
items.properties:
Medium Armor
Armor Class: 15 + Dex Modifier (max 2)
Disadvantage on Stealth
items.author: SRD

items.name: Hallowed Skin
items.description: A thick, flesh-like leather vest adorned with occult symbols and human teeth. Parts of it are ragged with wear, and it feels clammy to the touch.
items.properties: Grants 12 AC +Dex. Undead creatures revere the bearer of this garment, and will not attack you, unless they are in threat of being destroyed. A good-aligned character wearing this vest will become nauseous, and suffers fitful nightmares on any night after this has been worn, preventing them from benefitting from a long rest.
items.author: /u/gimme_some_sunshine

items.name: Headband of Enslavement
items.description: Description needed.

items.name: Heavenly Armor
items.description:
A set of enhanced, heavenly armor. Powerful enough to protect and shield a hero on his journey through the the world, or even beyond the Gates of Hell itself. These armors are made for the most faithful and divine mortals and angels alike.
While wearing this armor, you gain a +2 bonus to AC, you have advantage on all saving throws against effects caused by fiends, and it creates an aura in a 5-foot radius around you. Fiends in the aura have disadvantage on saving throws.
items.properties: Light, Medium or Heavy

items.name: Hide Armor
items.description: This crude armor consists of thick furs and pelts. It is commonly worn by barbarian tribes, evil humanoids, and other folk who lack access to the tools and materials needed to create better armor.
items.properties:
Medium Armor
Armor Class: 12 + Dex Modifier (max 2)
items.author: SRD

items.name: Jallak's Shield
items.description: A small steel shield with a triangular shape. It is emblazoned with a griffon device in red on a field of gray. This battered shield is inscribed on the interior with the words: “May this shield be your protection in battle, Jallak. Honor the Galbrand name.”
items.properties: Wielding a shield increases your Armor Class by 2. You can benefit from only one shield at a time.
items.author: Unknown

items.name: Knife Vest
items.description: A padded vest of hardened leather, the breastplate of which has been fitted with 12 small sheaths designed for throwing knives.
items.properties:
Light Armor
Armor Class: 11 + Dex Modifier
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description: The breastplate and shoulder protectors of this armor are made of leather that has been stiffened by being boiled in oil. The rest of the armor is made of softer and more flexible materials.
items.properties:
Light Armor
Armor Class: 11 + Dex Modifier
items.author: SRD

items.name: Links of Truth
items.description: Plain, but exceptionally clean chainmail that feels light, and always cold.
items.properties: Grants 13 AC +Dex. If the bearer tells a lie, the armor will fall into hundreds of metal rings. If the lie is redeemed, the armor will reassemble itself.
items.author: /u/gimme_some_sunshine

items.name: Mithral Breastplate
items.description: This armor consists of a fitted mithral chest piece worn with supple leather. Although it leaves the legs and arms relatively unprotected, this armor provides good protection for the wearer's vital organs while leaving the wearer relatively unencumbered.
items.properties:
Medium Armor
Armor Class: 14 + Dex Modifier (max 2)
items.author: PHB

items.name: Mithral Chain Mail Armor
items.description: Made of interlocking metal rings, chain mail includes a layer of quilted fabric worn underneath the mail to prevent chafing and to cushion the impact of blows. The suit includes gauntlets.
items.properties:
Heavy Armor
Armour Class: 16
items.author: PHB

items.name: Mithral Chain Shirt
items.description: Made of interlocking metal rings, a chain shirt is worn between layers of clothing or leather. This armor offers modest protection to the wearer's upper body and allows the sound of the rings rubbing against one another to be muffled by outer layers.
items.properties:
Medium Armor
Armor Class: 13 + Dex Modifier (max 2)
items.author: PHB

items.name: Mithral Half Plate Armor
items.description: Shaped mithral plates that cover most of the wearer's body. It does not include leg protection beyond simple greaves that are attached with leather straps.
items.properties:
Medium Armor
Armor Class: 15 + Dex Modifier (max 2)
items.author: PHB

items.name: Mithral Plate Armor
items.description: Plate consists of shaped, interlocking metal plates to cover the entire body. A suit of plate includes gauntlets, heavy leather boots, a visored helmet, and thick layers of padding underneath the armor. Buckles and straps distribute the weight over the body.
items.properties:
Heavy Armor
Armour Class: 18
items.author: PHB

items.name: Mithral Ring Mail Armor
items.description: This armor is leather armor with heavy rings sewn into it. The rings help reinforce the armor against blows from swords and axes. Ring mail is inferior to chain mail, and it's usually worn only by those who can't afford better armor.
items.properties:
Heavy Armor
Armor Class: 14
items.author: PHB

items.name: Mithral Scale Mail Armor
items.description: This armor consists of a coat and leggings of leather covered with overlapping pieces of mithral, much like the scales of a fish. The suit includes gauntlets.
items.properties:
Medium Armor
Armor Class: 14 + Dex Modifier (max 2)
items.author: PHB

items.name: Mithral Splint Armor
items.description: This armor is made of narrow vertical strips of metal riveted to a backing of leather that is worn over cloth padding. Flexible chain mail protects the joints.
items.properties:
Heavy Armor
Armour Class: 17
items.author: PHB

items.name: Old Round Shield
items.description: An old round shield. Beneath the boss is the dwarven script for "Valiant conduct by the bearer may draw the eye of the gods".
items.properties: Wielding this shield increases your Armor Class by 1. You can benefit from only one shield at a time.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Padded Armor
items.description: Padded armor consists of quilted layers of cloth and batting.
items.properties:
Light Armor
Armor Class: 11 + Dex Modifier
Disadvantage on Stealth
items.author: SRD

items.name: Plate Armor
items.description: Plate consists of shaped, interlocking metal plates to cover the entire body. A suit of plate includes gauntlets, heavy leather boots, a visored helmet, and thick layers of padding underneath the armor. Buckles and straps distribute the weight over the body.
items.properties:
Heavy Armor
Armour Class: 18
Disadvantage on Stealth
items.author: SRD

items.name: Rafting Cloak
items.description: An cherrywood cloak that repels water perfectly.
items.properties: This cloak may be spread like a blanket over open water. When it is, it can support up to 300 lbs as a raft, staying perfectly buoyant and supportive even in moderately choppy conditions.
items.author: /u/gimme_some_sunshine

items.name: Ring Mail Armor
items.description: This armor is leather armor with heavy rings sewn into it. The rings help reinforce the armor against blows from swords and axes. Ring mail is inferior to chain mail, and it's usually worn only by those who can't afford better armor.
items.properties:
Heavy Armor
Armor Class: 14
Disadvantage on Stealth
items.author: SRD

items.name: Ring Mail of Three Wishes
items.description: This armor is Leather Armor with heavy rings sewn into it. The rings help reinforce the armor against blows from swords and axes. Three rings across the chest are made of brilliant gold that sheds dim light similar to daybreak.
items.properties: When you are hit by a melee or ranged attack while wearing this armor, you can use your reaction to wish that you hadn't been hit. The attack deals no damage, but the armor class provided by the armor decreases by 1. After the third wish, the armor's rings vanish and it becomes nonmagical leather armor.
items.author: /u/gimme_some_sunshine

items.name: Scale Mail Armor
items.description: This armor consists of a coat and leggings (and perhaps a separate skirt) of leather covered with overlapping pieces of metal, much like the scales of a fish. The suit includes gauntlets.
items.properties:
Medium Armor
Armor Class: 14 + Dex Modifier (max 2)
Disadvantage on Stealth
items.author: SRD

items.name: Shadoweave Armor
items.description: Shadoweave armor is woven with darkness imbued into its silk. +6 armor +6 max bonus

items.name: Sharkskin Armour
items.description: Studded leather armor made from sharkskin set with iron disks.
items.properties:
Light Armor
Armor Class: 12 + Dex Modifier

items.name: Shield
items.description: A shield is made from wood or metal and is carried in one hand.
items.properties: Wielding a shield increases your Armor Class by 2. You can benefit from only one shield at a time.
items.author: SRD

items.name: Smoldering Cloak
items.description: A black and crimson cloak with tattered edges that are ever-glowing as it were on fire on moments ago.
items.properties: If an attack would strike you in combat, you may use your reaction to become a cloud of thick, black smoke, and may move up to 15 feet without provoking attacks of opportunity. You must complete a short rest before using this ability again. If you suffer 10 or more fire damage from any source, the feature becomes available again.
items.author: /u/gimme_some_sunshine

items.name: Splint Armor
items.description: This armor is made of narrow vertical strips of metal riveted to a backing of leather that is worn over cloth padding. Flexible chain mail protects the joints.
items.properties:
Heavy Armor
Armour Class: 17
Disadvantage on Stealth
items.author: SRD

items.name: Studded Leather Armor
items.description: Made from tough but flexible leather, studded leather is reinforced with close-set rivets or spikes.
items.properties:
Light Armor
Armor Class: 12 + Dex Modifier
items.author: SRD

items.name: The Olm Shield
items.description: A circular shield with an amber edge, and covered in a lustrous, gold-colored metal. On the face of the shield is a depiction of a man destroying a dragon while the dragon destroys the man, as in an ouroboros.
items.properties:
Grants +2 AC when equipped. 

While carried, it grants immunity to fear effects, and you have advantage on Charisma skill checks to inspire others. If the shield is struck with Dragonfire, the bearer is enveloped with amber scales, grants resistance to fire damage, increases size by 1 category, and grants a fly speed of 60 for as long as you remain in combat.
items.author: /u/gimme_some_sunshine

items.name: Troll-Rubber Boots
items.description: Troll-rubber boots.
items.properties: They give a +1 to stealth movement.
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: "The Art of Potionmaking" by Zygmunt Brigge
items.description: A large, leather-bound tome has a large illustrated potion vial stitched into the front cover. Above the illustration, written in Dwarven is the title; "The Art of Potionmaking". Further examination reveals this to be a comprehensive guide to potionmaking written by a Dwarf called Zygmunt Brigge.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: A Dungeon of One's Own
items.description: A dusty scroll which contains a political essay written by a witch called Virginia Woolfsblood. The essay delves into the systemic oppression of witches and advocates for the magical education and liberation of women in general.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: A Study of Orcs, by Darius Woodherd
items.description: A large tome bound in thick bison-hide that is a common-orcish language primer, as well as a primer on orcish culture. The author of the primer, Darius Woodherd, seems to have added a lot of information on orcish heraldry and politics, as well. Darius spent almost twenty years amongst the orcs of the north, and eventually married an orc before being killed a score of years ago in a rival tribe’s ambush.
items.properties: Grants a +2 circumstance check on speaking orcish, knowledge of orcish history and heraldry, and on diplomacy checks with orcs.
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Among the Kobolds
items.description: A detailed account of an adventurer who lived in an Kobold tribe for a number of years. You get a sense that there may have been some embellishment at some points, but it is otherwise an interesting examination of their general nature.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Ancient Tome
items.description: A tome whose pages have been yellowed with age and used to press metallic leaves of gold, silver, platinum, brass, copper, and bronze.
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Armentarious' Scroll Tube
items.description: A very large scroll tube containing the plans for many of the ancient war engines of Armentarious.
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Blood-Soaked Book
items.description: A blood-soaked book; a partially written history about a long-lost keep on the borderlands. The last written page is done in a different hand, and is scrawled with “The rules have changed!” in large, bold letters. Roughly a third of the book (of 100 pages) has been used.
items.author: Unknown

items.name: Carthus Tome of Pyromancy
items.description: An old pyromancy tome from Carthus containing pyromancies crafted for battle. It gives the impression it might have fallen through from a different plane of existence.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Colloquial Black Speech for Orcs, Trolls and Men
items.description: This book appears to be a phrasebook for those looking to learn the basics of the Orcish language. It has an entire section of swear words, which is most amusing. The book seems to have an effect on anyone using the phrase book to speak in Black Speech. They become prone to shouting louder and louder the less they are understood. Nobody knows why this is; the book is not magical in the slightest.
items.properties: Enables the reader to speak basic Orcish phrases.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Frolee's Guide to Follicle Perfection
items.description: A wizard called Frolee appears to have mass produced a five page guide to mustaches and beards. It has a unique, hairy cover made out of bearskin.
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Holy Book
items.description: An old tome, written for the clergy of Pelor. It has a stiff leather dust jacket which has been worn down on the spine and a broken clasp once used to attach a chain
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: How to Win Friends and Influence People
items.description: This book peddles a philosophy of personal ascendancy and manipulation by charisma alone. The authors and advocates of such tomes claim that, by drawing on the most recent theories in sociology and interpersonal psychology, it is possible to raise an individual's charisma by a single point. They're wrong, that can only be done by magic, but what you read is your own.
items.author: BGII

items.name: Kilan Wester's Royal Recipes
items.description: A large tome filled with over one hundred recipes for wild boar, goose, and venison; written by Kilan Wester, a former royal chef (retired).
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Learning Languages by Chompsky
items.description: A book detailing the general process of learning a language, from both a practical and theoretical angle. Written by a talented linguist called Chompsky the Gnome.
items.properties: Allows any natural speaker of a language to be considered an "instructor" of that language.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Libatius Borage's Advanced Potion Making
items.description: A large tome which details advanced techniques in the field of potion making. It's dust cover is a little tatty but the pages inside have kept well and it still has plenty of life left in it.
items.properties: Grants advantage to Alchemy checks.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Mallius Metallius, A Layman's Guide to Metallurgy
items.description: This tome has been bound in iron plates, giving the sense that it could take a real beating if needed. It's been well kept, however, and inscribed in the front is the title, "Mallius Metallius" with the subtitle, "A Layman's Guide to Metallurgy".
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Manual of Bodily Health
items.description: A typical manual of bodily health provides the reader with valuable information regarding preventative medicine, basic first aid, and proper muscle toning.
items.author: BGII

items.name: Manual of Gainful Exercise
items.description: A typical Manual of Gainful Exercise provides the reader with a strictly regimented routine of daily stretches and tests designed to increase muscle bulk.
items.author: BGII

items.name: Manual of Quickness of Action
items.description: A typical manual of quickness of action provides the reader with a wide variety of tips and pointers regarding the motion and coordination of one's hands and feet. This small tome is much in demand by people from many walks of life, including rogues wishing to improve their slight-of-hand and paladins wanting to perfect their thrust and parry.
items.author: BGII

items.name: Menesta's Book of Stored Skill
items.description: This magical book has no discernable writings on the outside, or on any page. As soon as it is opened up, ask the player for the first three skills that come to mind. As soon as they tell you, the first page of the book becomes a table of contents with three chapters. The names of the chapters are the three skills they mentioned. Turning to the page of a skill chapter causes the book to disappear in a colored burst of light—and leaves the user with a permanent +1 rank to said skill. If their ranks are maxed out, the book is wasted.
items.author: /u/LittleDizzleDaGusha

items.name: Moradin's Magical Bestiary
items.description: A bestiary!

items.name: Orcish Cookbook
items.description: This appears to be a cookbook written by an unnamed Orc. It has some insightful notes on how best to cook Owlbear and a rather unpleasant section on what spices go well with human flesh.
items.author: BGII

items.name: Outdated Book of Prophecies
items.description: A small, leather-bound book filled with prophecies. All of them will be found to be true, but the last of them is dated just a few weeks ago.
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Romeot and Julio
items.description: One of the most famous plays in the works of the famous Orcish bard "Villam Spearshaker". It tells the story of two starcrossed lovers whose familes are locked in a bitter rivalry. They attempt to run away together only to end up eaten by an ogre. The ogre then proceeds to eat most of the two feuding families, all of the side characters, and in a number of early renditions of the play a few members of the audience as well. A note to budding directors: Try not to cast an actual ogre as the ogre.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Romeot and Julio II
items.description: A sequel to the original play by the famous Orcish bard; Villam Speakshaker. Romeot and Julio (or at least, what's left of them) are ressurected as shambling zombies in service to a wealthy merchant. The play ends with the merchant attempting to extract a pound of flesh from Romeot to pay for a debt before getting eaten alive by the two zombies. Their final moments of the play are spent lovingly feeding each other his bloody entrails.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Scroll of Cursed Gibberish
items.description: Without a successful Arcana check of 25, this scroll appears to be a Scroll of Comprehend Language. When used, however a DC save must be made or the user will be unable to speak anything but gibberish for 1d20 days.

items.name: Scroll of Summon Moose
items.description: Summons a moose.

items.name: Seimai's Guide to Healing Tonics
items.description: A relatively small compendium of information about healing tonics.
items.properties: Grants advantage to Medicine checks.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Service Record
items.description: A scroll detailing the bound service of two men-at-arms sworn to six months of service.

items.name: The Book of Kaza
items.description: The Book of Kaza is a famed tome written by the lich, Kaza. It is said to deal with the darkest secrets of necromancy, though the pages appear to be blank when you look at it. Kaza was destroyed during the upheaval of Nethril's final days. How it has come to its present location after so many years is anyone's guess.
items.author: BGII

items.name: The Book of Monster Recipes
items.description: This leather-bound recipe book appears to be aimed at adventurers who aren't satified with merely fighting monsters and taking their treasure. It features a mixed selection of recipies, with side-notes on how best to prepare the remains of each creature included. "Braized Dragon Liver and Onions", "Eye of the Beholder Soup", "Rust Monster Jerky" and "Gelatinous Cube Jelly" are particular standouts.
items.properties: Allows the reader to prepare meals from most common monsters without poisoning themselves.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: The Recipes and Ruminations of One Dradeel of Tethir
items.description: The Recipes and Ruminations of One Dradeel of Tethir is a book with food recipes from Dradeel. Even a casual look will inform the reader that he was a wizard with an addled mind.
items.author: BGII

items.name: The Three Rules to Poisoncraft
items.description: This tatty old tome is missing a number of pages, leaving whatever the third rule of Poisoncraft completely unknown. Hopefully you'll manage with the first two, unlike whomever owned this book before you.
items.properties: Grants advantage to Alchemy checks.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Tome of Alchemy
items.description: A large tome, bound in leather and clasped with gold. A closer inspection of this volume will reveal that each page is perfectly preserved dragon scale which has been inscribed with the black blood of a fiend. The book describes the four spirits (quicksilver, orpiment, sal ammoniac, sulfur) and seven bodies (gold, silver, iron, quicksilver, lead, tin, copper) of traditional alchemy.
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Tome of Clear Thought
items.description: A typical Tome of Clear Thought contains a collection of esoteric and scholarly literature, often involving obscure mathematical or algebraic formulae or the occasional reference to inter-planar biology..
items.author: BGII

items.name: Tome of Understanding
items.description: A typical Tome of Understanding contains a sober, if dry analysis of legal battles, historic events, government policies, philosophical treatises and theories of magic and metaphysics.
items.properties: Grants advantage to History checks.
items.author: BGII

items.name: Bottle
items.description: Once per day, restores 4d2 HP.This goes up to 4d4 at 5, 6d4 at 10,  8d4 at 15 and 10d4 at 20. Cannot use during Combat

items.name: Bottle of Giant's Urine
items.description: This bottle stinks before it's even been opened. The stench of it's contents will protect whomever can stomach to wear it from almost any wandering predators. It's very difficult to get said stench out of adventuring gear, however. Potency may vary on weather, but it should ward of predators for at least a day or two.
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Dragon Balm
items.description: Dragon balm – reduced heat damage
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Elixir of Madness
items.description: Upon taking a single sip of this potion, you are afflicted with some form of madness. Roll 1d6. On a 1-3 you are afflicted with a short-term madness (DMG p. 259); on a 4-5 you are afflicted with a long-term madness (DMG p. 260); on a 6 you are afflicted with an indefinite madness.(DMG p. 260). The remainder of the elixir loses its magical properties, becoming merely a foul tasting liquid.
items.properties: Cursed.
items.author: D&D Wiki

items.name: Frostbite Lilly
items.description: A pure white lily that becomes rigid when picked. Its petals are icy cold and shatter like glass if mishandled.
items.properties: If kept intact, this flower will refrigerate any container smaller than a 6x6x6 cube for up to one week. The six petals may be plucked and crushed, creating a sheen of ice in a 10 foot radius. If used over water, this will freeze 3 inches thick.
items.author: /u/gimme_some_sunshine

items.name: Giggle Water
items.properties: small vial of liquid that when drunk makes the drinker continuously giggle for 1 hour. When that wears off they hiccup for 1 hour

items.name: Grog of Substantial Whimsy
items.description: http://www.dandwiki.com/wiki/Grog_of_Susbtantial_Whimsy_%283.5e_Equipment%29

items.name: Holy Water
items.description: Three vials of holy water.
items.properties: See PHB page

items.name: Honeysuckle Potion
items.description: A small, crystal vial of a clear, viscous liquid that smells strongly of honeysuckle.
items.properties: Drinking this potion will heal a character 1d4 - 1 health.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Iron Flask
items.description: An iron flask holding a viscous liquid of intense, emerald-green that smells faintly of citrus fruit. The liquid is a concentrated, magical dye for clothing and the like, equal to four full barrels of normal dye. If consumed, it turns the drinker green for a full month.

items.name: Java Potion
items.description: Made from beans that were crushed to a fine powder and robbed of all but a trace of their natural essence, which would be criminal had the beans not been canephora rubbish to start with.
items.properties: 1d4 + 1 Healing
items.author: Fable II

items.name: Magmatic Elixir
items.description: A viscous potion in a clear glass bottle. It is uncomfortably hot to hold, and glows a faint orange in darkness.
items.properties: When you drink this potion, make a constitution saving throw with a DC of 14. If you fail the save, you painfully vomit the substance, and suffer 2d6 fire damage. Otherwise, you gain the ability to breath fire for ten minutes. Breathing on enemies deals 2d6 + your current level in damage to foes in a 15 foot line, and ignites flammable objects.
items.author: /u/gimme_some_sunshine

items.name: Nevermore Seed
items.description: A small pouch of tiny dry seeds that leave black soot on your fingers and smell of pungent incense.
items.properties: Throwing these seeds causes shadowy ravens to appear from thin air to invade a 15 ft area. The ravens create a cloud of inky soot that grants full cover to the affected area. The affected targets also take 2d6 damage at the beginning of each turn each turn inside the area. Lasts 1 minute, the pouch contains 5 handfuls.
items.author: /u/gimme_some_sunshine

items.name: Nightmare Pipeweed
items.description: A common looking pipeweed, which smells only a little sweeter than the most common varieties. Close inspection reveals occasional black burrs mixed among the leaves.
items.properties: Smoking this pipeweed causes a brief feeling of relaxation and elation. A few minutes in, however, the experience falls into terror. The smoker will hallucinate that they are being pursued by a nightmarish figment that is never fully visible. The pursuer will never actually reach them, but if the smoker fails a wisdom check of DC 15, they will be compelled to flee in a random direction for ten minutes.
items.author: /u/gimme_some_sunshine

items.name: Philter of Blave
items.description: A viscous, golden liquid inside of a corked glass vial.
items.properties: After drinking the potion, you are compelled to speak first in every conversation and become unable to say anything which is not a deliberate and blatant lie. You believe the lies yourself [and reality itself can alter in minor ways, as determined by the DM, to reflect what you say. Your lies cannot place yourself or any other creature in immediate physical harm]. For the duration of the effect, you automatically succeed on saving throws against any spell or effect which would compel you to speak the truth. These effects last for 1 hour.
items.author: /u/gimme_some_sunshine

items.name: Phoenix Restorative Potion
items.description: Potion 3: Phoenix Restorative. The next time the drinker is reduced to 0 hit points, they deal area fire damage, and return to full health, only happens once. The player has no special knowledge this is true, but the flavor of the draught burns their throat but leaves them feeling oddly optimistic. Fire damage dealt should be based on circumstance, but if you can get away with lots, it'd be the most fun.
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Pink Nayla Petal
items.description: A thick, velvety flower petal of pastel pink and flecks of red. It leaves a fragrant, pleasant dust on your fingertips.
items.properties: Placing the petal over a wound causes it to meld with flesh, restoring half of the subject's maximum hit points. The recipient's skin color will permanently change to a pastel pink wherever this is applied.
items.author: /u/gimme_some_sunshine

items.name: Potion of Extra Health
items.description: A foul smelling liquid that shifts between bright red and burgundy as it swirls around it's flask.
items.properties:
User gains 1d2 HP per level and will regenerate 1d2HP per round. 
The effect is lost the next time the drinker goes to the toilet.
items.author: Unknown

items.name: Potion of False Bluff
items.description: A potion vial containing a sweet. honey-smelling golden syrup. There is a label on the vial written in common, which reads "Potion of Deception".
items.properties: The drinker of the potion perceives that they are an amazing liar. They believe that every bluff, diplomacy, and intimidation check they make for the next 1d4 hours succeeds, whether it does or not.
items.author: Unknown

items.name: Potion of Harmless Flaying
items.description: A pearlescent green potion in a glass vial that seems to swirl playfully when started at.
items.properties: 1d4 rounds after drinking this potion target produces the illusions of his/her innards becoming outards for 1d6 minutes. The illusion is entirely intangible, but nonetheless real looking.
items.author: Sherwood Bosco

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A character who drinks the magical red fluid in this vial regains 2d4 + 2 hit points. Drinking or administering a potion takes an action.
items.author: PHB

items.name: Potion of Lycanthropy Immunization
items.description: A thick green potion in a small clear bottle. Closer examination reveals silver particles suspended in the liquid.
items.properties:
Drinking this potion will prevent you from being cursed with lycanthropy. 
Effective for one day.
items.author: D&D Wiki

items.name: Potion of Purple Ooze
items.description: A potion vial containing a purple concoction, labelled simply "Ooze". The bubbling, slimy fluid is dark purple with emerald accretions on the side. It smells like butyric acid (vomit) and tastes worse.
items.properties: Drinking this potion will turn you into an ooze for 1d8+1 days.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Potion of Sudden Translocation
items.description: Inside this strangely shaped vial swirls a blackish purple liquid. When used it will randomly and instantly teleport the user to a free spot up to 50 feet away. This includes through walls, into pits and between floors. However the potion will not work if you are otherwise prevented from teleporting either by Dimensional shackles or other by means.
items.properties: Teleport to a random spot up to 50 feet away. One use only.
items.author: D&D Wiki

items.name: Potion of Temporary Immortality
items.description: Bottle with a liquid with rainbow colors. When you drink it you automatically succeed on death saving throws for one hour.
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Pouch of Healing Potions
items.description: A large carry pouch made from the skin of a monkey. Inside are 1d6 Potions of Healing.
items.properties: You regain 2d4 + 2 hit points when you drink these potions. The potion's red liquid glimmers when agitated.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Pouch of Healing Potions
items.description: A large carry pouch made from the skin of a monkey. Inside are 1d6 Potions of Greater Healing.
items.properties:
You regain 4d4 + 4 hit points when you drink this potion. 
The potion's red liquid glimmers when agitated.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Pouch of Healing Potions
items.description: A large carry pouch made from the skin of a monkey. Inside are 1d6 Potions of Superior Healing.
items.properties:
You regain 8d4 + 8 hit points when you drink this potion. 
The potion's red liquid glimmers when agitated.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Pouch of Healing Potions
items.description: A large carry pouch made from the skin of a monkey. Inside are 1d6 Potions of Superior Healing.
items.properties:
You regain 10d4 + 10 hit points when you drink this potion. 
The potion's red liquid glimmers when agitated.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Shell Paste Lotion
items.description: A small metal tin which has been carefully labelled. Instructions are included on the inside of the lid, "Smear on bare skin to grow a natural defence." The paste inside is white and gritty. It smells like coconut.
items.properties: Smearing Shell Paste lotion on your bare skin will cause an exoskeleton to grow for 1d4 hours. This exoskeleton increases your AC by 1.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Ancient Temple Replica
items.description: Miniature golden replica of ancient mythical temple – location map inside
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Blood Scroll
items.description: A scroll that when signed with blood would enter the participant into an assassin ranking system. Upon the scroll was also an arrow that always pointed to the assassin that was a rank above you. The goal is to reach rank 1 for a single wish however the only way to gain a rank is to kill the assassin above you. The Rank is infamous and well paid for their trade so strong assassins are always waiting for a rank opening.
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Companion Cube
items.description: A Companion Cube: It was created by a wizard who had stuck himself in a tower to show complete dedication to his studies. However, after several decades he became so lonely that he chose to make a friend... literally. Using what little non-component materials he had laying around his tower, he created a small cube and gave it sentience. It was able to communicate telepathically with anyone who made a link with the cube. Unfortunately, the wizard eventually died and the cube became lonely. Unable to travel and find a new friend, the cube simply sat there and waited for anyone to come along. Anyone seeing the cube would be compelled to be with the cube and have it in their possession. Upon holding the cube, they would feel the need to keep it with them at all times, and protect it as if it were their own child. Little by little, the connection between the cube and it's possessor would grow, until the two would be inseparable.
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Debt of a Soul
items.description: Debt of a Soul – contract of soul ownership
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Gold Plated Idols
items.description: Gold plated idols – possession = death penalty
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Mammoth Sword
items.description: A sword of truly mammoth proportions. Resting within a chamber more than thirty meters long, the sword stretches from one end to the other. Whatever creature was meant to wield this mighty weapon would truly stagger the imagination of a dragon.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Old Guard's Note
items.description: Within a rotten pouch found upon the body of a long dead soldier is a parchment with an unbroken seal. If the seal is broken and the message read, it warns its would-be recipient to guard against an eminent betrayal.

items.name: Polymorphed Adventurers Potions
items.description: The potions are a polymorphed group of famous heroes transformed into oozes. Anyone with the ability to communicate telepathically are able to speak with them (and probably help them get back to normal).
items.author: DangerousPuhson

items.name: Royal Documents
items.description: Collection of documents with traces of royal bloodlines

items.name: Sales Receipt
items.description: Receipt for delivery of slaves

items.name: Slave Order
items.description: A bearer-order allowing the possessor to take ownership of a dozen slaves from Zoealage the flesh-monger
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Treasure Map I
items.description: Piece of Legendary weapon & map with possible locations for other pieces

items.name: Treasure Map II
items.description: A peg leg inscribed with a pirate’s treasure map. The map is either false or its treasure has long since been plundered. If you wish to provide the PCs with a true map, then one may be found in the hollow compartment within the leg.

items.name: Water Damaged Ledger
items.description: Water damaged ledger – hidden location

items.name: Bull's Head Ring
items.description: A silver ring shaped into the likeness of a bull’s head.

items.name: Companion Rings
items.description: Two rings, user may opt to take damage for the other person wearing the ring

items.name: God Ring
items.description: Ring of a god

items.name: Magical Ring of Engagement
items.description: Someone used this to get married, and for them it really was a magical moment.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Observer's Ring
items.description: This ring is set with a hemispherical glass eyeball that looks around when it is worn. It functions as an alternative eye for the user and is not affected by magic.

items.name: Ring of Bad Luck
items.properties: This ring will appear to be a Ring of Good Luck without an appraise check of 25. It actually imbues the wearer -1 on all saves and is not removable for a full day without removing the enchantment.

items.name: Ring of Contrariness
items.properties: This magical ring is cursed, making its wearer unable to agree with any idea, statement, or action. Once attuned, the ring can be removed only after a Remove Curse spell is cast upon the individual wearing it. Because of the cure, the wearer will resist any attempts to cast such a spell.

items.name: Ring of Dubious Might
items.description: A silver ring, encrusted with a small topaz. Upon wearing it on their finger, the wearer feels incredibly strong and confident. However, entering combat, their confidence immediately dissipates, leaving them terrified.
items.author: Jacos

items.name: Ring of Fake Invisibility
items.description: A silver ring inlaid with a trasluscent pearl. There is an inscription in Elvish which reads, "To Elabella, perhaps now you will find your mirror less engrossing."
items.properties: The wearer of this ring is unable to see themselves or anything they are carrying.

items.name: Ring of Ghosts
items.description: Ring of Ghosts: the wearer of the ring can see and communicate with the ghost of any intelligent being that has died in the past 24 hours within a 1 mile radius. After the 24 hours, the ghost disappears. The ghosts are only visible and audible to the wearer, but remain intangible. Also, the ghosts likely aren't very cooperative if the players killed them.

items.name: Ring of Good Luck
items.description: This ring imbues the wearer +1 on all saves.

items.name: Ring of Returning
items.description: Sometimes called a "Back to the Beginning" ring. This is a band of cold silvery metal, the ring looks deceptively simple at first glance. Only when held close do faint runes reveal themselves—etched so finely they seem to shimmer in and out of sight, like ripples on still water.
items.properties: When you take off this ring and it transports you to where you first put it on and disappears.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Ring of Sustenance
items.description: Ring of Sustenance – require no food/water/rations

items.name: Ring of the Adventurous Limb
items.description: If worn on a hand, the entire arm will vanish.  It will return after 24 hours have elapsed.  Roll a d10: 1 - tattoo on arm, 2 - arm injured, 3 - gained a ring, probably a wedding ring, 4 - ring missing, 5-10 - nothing special.  It will have a similar effect on legs.

items.name: Signet Ring of Gold
items.description: A large signet ring of gold, worked with a unicorn crest. Any commoner who dons the ring will suddenly discover its metal heated to unbearable levels – causing one hit point of damage per round. However, anyone with noble blood (however slight), or destined to become a noble at some point in the future, who does the same will suffer only a momentary flash of pain (with an accompanying 1 hp of damage). They will find that the unicorn crest has reshaped itself to their own heraldry, which has also been branded in miniature form upon the back of the finger. From this point forward, they can put on or remove the ring at will without any further ill effects.

items.name: The Iron Thorn
items.description: This wrought-iron band is pitted and stained as if by acid. Between the two thorns formed by the band, a crude lump of silver on its head suggests the image of a skull against a black field, perhaps the symbol of Myrkul, Lord of Bones.
items.properties: Upon attunement this ring changes it's wearer's appearance to that of a Zombie. Requires "Remove Curse" to remove.
items.author: BG

items.name: Vanishing Ring
items.description: A simple silver ring that, when looked at in bright light, doesn't seem to be entirely opaque.
items.properties: After half a day of wearing this ring, it disappears completely and is not found again.
items.author: /u/SPYROHAWK

items.name: "Eau D'Ogre" Perfume
items.description: Someone has managed to cram all the stench of an Ogre into one reeking bottle. Why? The world may never know. No human should ever willingly apply this to their body or attire.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: 48-sided Garnet Gemstone
items.description: Garnet is a general class of crystals ranging from deep red to violet in colour. a typical cut for this rare isometric gem is 12 to 24 sides, with the very rare 36 sides being known from time to time. This may be the only 48 sided garnet in existance. and as such it is highly prized.
items.author: BGII

items.name: Adamantine Dust
items.description: This is a small jar of Adamantine dust, most likely the end result of exposing a Drow item to the light of day. It seems the previous owner wasn't quite ready to let go of it.
items.author: Baldur's Gate II

items.name: Agni Mani Necklace
items.description: A necklace patterened with Agni Mani. These ornamental stones were usually found in desert regions. In the Realms, the name applies specifically only to black tektite material.
items.author: Baldur's Gate

items.name: Air Elemental Statue
items.description: This enchanted statuette depicts the swirling form of an air elemental. When stood close, you can feel a cooling breeze swirling around the statuette.
items.author: Baldur's Gate II

items.name: Alexandrite Emerald
items.description: A transparent dark green Alexandrite emerald.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Amber Gemstone
items.description: An amber gemstone of watery gold colouring. It has been polished so that you can see a small petrified leaf suspended inside.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Amethyst
items.description: A common, bright purple gemstone.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Amethyst Drinking Cup
items.description: An ornate cup fashioned out of a deep purple Amethyst. This material was probably chosen as many believe it to prevent intoxication.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Ancient Coins
items.description: A cache of ancient coins left from the elder days of the world and made by a civilization utterly alien to the values of today: They are carved from bloodstone, moonstone, and jacinth – with unknown faces and unreadable runes decorating their surface.
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Ancient Gold Cube
items.description: Ancient gold cube – quite encumbering.
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Ancient Mummy
items.description: An ancient mummy which was given full burial rites and laid within a stately sarcophagus. Arranged on five pedestals around the sarcophagus are the canopic jars in which the mummy’s vital organs were placed. Although the mummy is not of the undead, opening these jars will reveal that its organs continue to function: The heart beats, the lungs fill with air and empty again, and so forth.
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Ancient Wand Box
items.description: A collection case holding fifty spent wands – crafted by the finest craftsman and enchanted by the mightiest wizards of a bygone age, but now reduced to mere wood, bone, and glass.
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Andar Gem
items.description: Andar is hard and durable, yielding translucent gems that flash green-red or brown-red when properly faceted.
items.author: Baldur's Gate

items.name: Animal Figurines
items.description: A small box of turquoise animal figurines.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Animated Toy Soldier
items.description: A tiny toy soldier which marches ceaselessly back and forth – eternally vigilant and pissed off if anyone disturbs.
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Anthracite Chair
items.description: In this room of the dungeon, there is an elaborate arm chair carved entirely of a single piece of coal. It has been inlaid with silver runes that age has rendered unreadable.
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Aphrodisiac Root
items.description: A dirty canvas bag containing twenty pounds of an aphrodisiac root.
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Aquamarine
items.description: Aquamarine is a hard, transparent form of beryl, blue-green in colour. These sought after gems are found primarily among the tribes that roam the tundra.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Aquamarine Necklace
items.description: A thick copper necklace set with a small aquamarine.
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Archon's Dream
items.description: It is said that this one was presented to an ancient ruler named Archon in a dream, as a gift from the gods. After the destruction of his kingdom, three of these "divinity" gems were scattered throughout the world, and though they have often been dismissed as nothing more than legends, thousands have devoted their lives to finding them.
items.author: Fable II

items.name: Armageddon Diorama
items.description: A tiny diorama made of oak and silver, depicting a prophecy of the last days of the world in vivid detail.
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Astrologer's Chart
items.description: An astrologer’s chart, inscribed with the finest instruments and the greatest precision upon a vellum which is both supple and expensive. Close inspection by those with the proper knowledge, however, reveals that these charts were constructed around an entirely different night sky – and, possibly, a calendrical system and length of year unlike anything known upon this world.
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Aumurille's Chest
items.description: A miniature golden chest with tiny emeralds lining the top that trace out a mage’s sigil. The chest is crafted in exquisite detail. (This is the material component of a “Secret Chest” (from the spell of the same name) for the ruthless lady-mage Aumurille, who will likely want it back....)
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Bag of Saffron
items.description: A small bag of saffron. It can be used to flavor the parties travel rations, but is probably more valuable as a trade good.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Bale of Furs
items.description: A large bale of rare furs.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Banded Agate Gem
items.description: A round translucent white gemstone with a ring of striped brown through its center.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Barrel o' Eels
items.description: A large barrel of pickled eels. The barrel can be re-used, but it's unlikely the smell of pickled eel will ever truly be washed out.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Barrel o' Nails
items.description: A newly crafted barrel filled with iron nails. Might be difficult for the players to get this around if they don't have a cart.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Battle Banner
items.description: A famous battle banner, long lost, smells badly
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Beaver Pelts
items.description: A string of eight beaver pelts.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Behir Horn
items.description: A stoppered behir horn containing 300 gp worth of powdered electrum
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Belt
items.description: An old leather belt.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Bird Cage
items.description: An antique golden bird cage with an electrum filigree.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Black Lotus Pollen
items.description: Four half-pound bricks of compressed Black Lotus pollen
items.properties: Potent poison. Very valuable to...the right people.
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Black Mountain Stout Recipe
items.description: A 1’ x 3’ bronze plate bearing the ancient, and secret recipe for Black Mountain Stout
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Black Opal
items.description: Black Opal has a greenish hue with black mottling and gold flecks. Usually found in ancient hot springs, the gem is tumbled smooth and cut cabochon. The phrase in the north "Black as an opal" is used as a subtle form of praise for kind-hearted rogues and the like.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Black Pearl
items.description: A dark blue-black Pearl.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Black Sapphire
items.description: A translucent lustrous black Sapphire with glowing highlights.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Black Velvet Mask
items.description: An ornate black velvet mask sitched with silver thread.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Blank Scroll
items.description: A blank scroll. It could have any spell in the world on it, eventually. The possibilities are endless.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Blood Stained Dress
items.description: A blood-stained dress which, despite being found in ruins which have lain undisturbed for centuries, is still a vibrant, stunning blue.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Blood Waterskin
items.description: Waterskin of lamb’s blood

items.name: Bloodstone
items.description: This dark red-brown heliotrope can sometimes be mistaken for a Stone of Invisibility but this one bears no overt magical powers.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Blue Dragon Figurine
items.description: A finely crafted figurine of a blue dragon, rampant, done in wood and painted.

items.name: Blue Quartz Gem
items.description: A small quartz gemstone shaped in a bevelled square. It is transparent pale blue in color.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Blue Sapphire Ring
items.description: A silver ring with a transparent blue-white sapphire.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Blue Scarf
items.description: A finely woven blue wool scarf.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Blue Spinel Ring
items.description: A silver ring with a Blue Spinel gemstone embedded on it.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Bone Butter Churn
items.description: A butter churn made of bone slats, bound with hoops of silver. A scrimshaw scene depicting a crowd of human villagers beating a Halfling with shovels and hoes wraps around it.
items.author: Unknown

items.name: Bone Dice
items.description: A pair of engraved bone dice.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Bone Fragments
items.description: Bits of bone from an unknown creature.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Bone Needle
items.description: A long needle carved out of bone.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Bookstand
items.description: A 5 ft. tall book stand in maple-wood, the front of which is carved into the likeness of three intertwined foxes.

items.name: Bottle Stopper
items.description: A reusable bottle cork embossed with gold leaf and set with amethysts.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Box of Evil Miniatures
items.description: A collection of humanoid figurines, each poised in an unspeakable act of evil. They are packed in box which has been wrapped in lamb’s wool.

items.name: Brass Chamber Pot
items.description: A brass chamber pot in which has been hidden 3 pieces of rosy quartz.

items.name: Brass Dragon Egg
items.description: A delicate brass dragon egg; hollowed out and painted into a seascape, resting on a wooden stand.

items.name: Brass Mug
items.description: A plain brass mug with a surprisingly ornate jade inlay.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Bronze Caltrops
items.description: A cask full of bronze caltrops.

items.name: Bronze Crown
items.description: An old bronze crown, once inlaid with gemstones. They have since been picked out, but the crown itself is wonderfully cast.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Bullet Bag
items.description: A small bag containing 58 clay sling bullets. Each bullet has a 12 gp opal hidden inside.

items.name: Bullette Horn Barding
items.description: A complete barding for a war horse made of Bullette horn plates.

items.name: Canary Diamond
items.description: A diamond of incredible beauty which slowly shifts its color from the purest white to canary to blue to black and back again.

items.name: Carnelian Gemstone
items.description: This is an opaque orange gemstone set in a small brooch.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Carved Beads
items.description: A string of wooden carved beads, tied into a bracelet.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Carved Bone Statuette
items.description: A carved ox bone female figure statue on a wooden base. The statue is 16" in height.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Carved Wooden Mantle
items.description: A carved wooden mantle, meant to be mounted above a fireplace, crafted of ash-wood and stained a medium brown. The left side is carved in images of demons and flames, the right in images of angels and air. The top is carved into an idyllic forest theme and has a moon above the left corner and a sun above the right.

items.name: Cat Pendant
items.description: An electrum pendant shaped like a curled-up cat.

items.name: Ceramic Jars
items.description: 4 ceramic canopic jars, holding the stomach, intestines, lungs, and liver of a long-ago monarch. Each has a golden lid with a likeness of a paunchy, hook-nosed man with pale skin and a squint.

items.name: Ceremonial Dagger
items.description: This is a ceremonial dagger made of electrum with a black pearl in it's pommel.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Chalcedony Gemstone
items.description: This pale white gemstone has a waxy luster and is slightly translucent.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Chalk
items.description: A small piece of chalk used to draw on any hard surface.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Chess Set
items.description: A large, boxed chess set. All the pieces are small, dead pixies somehow sealed within glass.

items.name: Chicken Eggs
items.description: A dozen chicken eggs; hollowed out and filled with white flour.

items.name: Child's Mittens and Hat
items.description: Rabbit-fur mittens and hat sized for a child.

items.name: Chrysoberyl Gem
items.description: Chrysoberyl is a hard, transparent, green gem which is usually facet-cut. It is said that Chrysoberyl has ties to the outer planes and hence its use with battling demonic possession and the undead.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Chrysoprase Gemstone
items.description: An apple-green gemstone consisting of a variety of chalcedony that contains nickel.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Citrine Gemstone
items.description: This golden gem has been expertly worked into an oval but has long since fallen out of whatever ring or brooch it was carved for.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Clàrsach Harp
items.description: A clàrsach harp in the style of the northern barbarians, but crafted with an elegance which suggests the decadence of a great civilization. Its strings are almost too fine to be perceived with the naked eye, and when they are played they resonate with the force of a full orchestra.
items.properties: Add your proficiency bonus to all Performance (Charisma) checks made when playing the harp.

items.name: Classy Shirt
items.description: A leather bag containing an embroidered black silk shirt with eight silver buttons.

items.name: Climbing Harness
items.description: A leather vest with climbing gear: 12 iron pitons, a hammer, 50’ of silk rope, a grappling hook, a set of bronze crampons, thick leather gloves, and a leather harness seat..

items.name: Cloak of Griffon Feathers
items.description: A cloak of griffon feathers set on black velvet.

items.name: Cloth Doll
items.description: A child’s cloth doll with a small silver brooch pinned to it in the shape of a butterfly.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Cloth Scrap
items.description: An old scrap of cloth from a shirt or sheet of some kind.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Cloth-of-gold Vestments
items.description: These holy garments are made of silk interwoven with gold threads.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Clothier's Dye
items.description: A small cask of yellow clothiers’ dye.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Cockatrice Statue
items.description: A life-sized copper and silver statuette of a cockatrice.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Comb
items.description: A small wooden comb.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Cooking Pot
items.description: A cast iron cooking pot. It smells like it was last used for soup.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Copper Acorns
items.description: Heavy, solid copper acorns with perfect natural detail.
items.properties: These acorns drop from the oak-like trees that sprout on the graves of Copper Dragons. They can be lethal when falling, often embedding themselves in the ground.
items.author: /u/gimme_some_sunshine

items.name: Copper Bars
items.description: Four bars of copper.

items.name: Copper Chalice
items.description: A small copper chalice with a silver filigree.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Copper Necklace
items.description: A copper necklace set with a small amulet shaped into a symbol representing the sun.

items.name: Copper Ring
items.description: A simple piece of jewlery.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Copper Tongue Scraper
items.description: A copper tongue scraper

items.name: Coral Circlet
items.description: A dark crimson Coral gemstone fitted into a golden circlet.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Cow
items.description: A cow. It's a real hoofer.

items.name: Crate of Chaos Mushrooms
items.description: This wooden crate is about 60cm by 60cm by 40cm, with 'Chaos Mushrooms' burned into the lid in Sylvan. It fizzes with a faint magical aura, and smells delicious
items.properties: The box contains 1d10+4 'Chaos Mushrooms', which are considered a delecacy at Fey dinner parties. If a creature eats one of the Chaos Mushrooms, they must roll on the Wild Magic Surge table (PHB, p104) and are subject to the result. Each mushroom eaten requires a seperate roll.
items.author: /u/Ragatan

items.name: Crown of Fingers
items.description: A crown of severed, mummified fingers. Each finger bears three jeweled rings.

items.name: Crude Box
items.description: A wooden box. Carved by someone who has had no formal training in woodworking, and it shows.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Crude Holy Symbol
