items.description: A crudely carved wooden holy symbol.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Crude Pipe
items.description: A crudely carved wooden pipe.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Crystal Prism
items.description: Crystal prism (d20 x 10 gp)

items.name: Crystal Pyramid
items.description: A finely-crafted, clear crystal pyramid with no noticeable impurities.
items.properties: If a creature focuses on the item for at least 30 seconds,  the creature sees a glimpse of a historical event in extraplanar history and takes 1d4 Int (psychic) damage. The image changes every 30 seconds of concentration and the creature takes 1d4 Int (psychic damage) for every event seen.

items.name: Crystal Vase
items.description: A large crystal vase, silver trimmed, with a dozen dead roses and some stagnant water within.

items.name: Curious Powder Box
items.description: Metal box of unidentifiable powder.
items.author: Unknown

items.name: Dead Fey
items.description: A long-dead fey, dried and petrified as a trophy and hanging from ceiling.
items.author: Unknown

items.name: Dead Rat
items.description: An old dead rat. It has begun to decay, and eminates an unpleasant smell.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Deck of Cards
items.description: An ancient deck of cards with five suits – clovers, swords, clubs, hearts, and dragons.

items.name: Deer Bust
items.description: The mounted head of a deer, it's impossibly massive horns have broken in places.
items.author: Unknown

items.name: Dehydrated Homunculi
items.description: A dried out and preserved homunculus. This one is a winged humanoid creature, similar to a small gargoyles or tiny demon. It's eye have been replaced with beads and it is stiff and unmoving.

items.name: Demon's Vale Wine
items.description: A one-gallon cask of Demon’s Vale Wine; a fiery red wine known to be made from hot peppers.
items.author: Unknown

items.name: Devil's Disk
items.description: Concave disk of black glass, 2 feet wide, made from obsidian. Etched with Infernal symbols.
items.properties:
When filled with water from the River Styx it becomes a beacon for desperate pleas from mortals. If there is a mortal creature that is in a desperate situation anywhere on the Material Plane the disk can form a connection with that mortal to create a contract. 
If a contract is made with that creature, it is bound by Asmodeus' will, and the user of the disk may do the following things:
			§ Travel through the Disk to the mortal for up to 10 minutes
			§ Pass objects through the Disk
			§ Reveal a secret to the mortal. You must spend a spell slot to obtain this secret. The higher level the spell slot the more information can be discovered.
			§ Cast a spell through the Disk to a target create that is within 50' of the desperate mortal
After a contract is made with a mortal, you can use the disk to contact that mortal again.
items.author: Lizardmaaaaan

items.name: Diamond
items.description: Diamond is a hard clear gem which can be clear blue-white, rich blue, yelow or pink. The hardest of all the gemstones, and among the most valuable. Diamonds are usually found in northern mountains by underground races, and then traded to the surface world.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Dice (6 Sided)
items.description: A six sided dice. Probably used in some silly tabletop game.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Dinosaur Bacon
items.description: 18 dried rashers of meat, possibly the largest rashers you have ever seen. They are wrapped in a sheep bladder cloth which has been labelled "THUNDERER MEAT" in large, rough handwriting.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Dire Bat Wings
items.description: Hanging from a drying rack are two large Dire Bat wings. It is unclear how long they have been seperated from the rest of the bat, but they are in good condition and could potentially be used as a crafting material.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Disk of Balance
items.description: A disk of finely polished stone. On one side, the Elvish rune for death is inscribed in blackest obsidian. Upon the other, the Dwarven rune for life is inscribed in the palest ivory.
items.author: Unknown

items.name: Dog Treats
items.description: These tender, juicy morsels contain rare seasonings with taste frequencies too high for human tongues.
items.author: Fable II

items.name: Door Rubble
items.description: The remnants of a massive door of stone which has been smashed into rubble. A magic mouth which had once adorned the door remains intact. As the PCs draw near it will issue its warning: “Disturb not this chamber, lest the world suffer.” Whatever the mouth was set to guard is gone – the chamber beyond the broken door is empty.

items.name: Dragon Banner
items.description: A battle pennant, triangular in shape, of a black dragon on red silk. The staff is a silver-tipped lance. (Pennant: 30gp, Lance: 25gp)

items.name: Dragon Comb Set
items.description: A set of golden combs shapes as dragons, each set with red garnets as the eyes.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Dragon Statuette
items.description: A statuette of a dragon, forged from the finest mithril, which responds to yes or no questions which are posed to it in draconic. The answers given may appear prophetic or oracular, but are actually random.

items.name: Dried Flower
items.description: A flower that has been dried out to preserve it.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Drow Medallion
items.description: An electrum drow house-medallion bearing the image of a crimson scorpion with the house name inscribed on the back in the drow tongue (House Ulrather).

items.name: Dust Ruby
items.description: A ruby the size of a man’s fist which sparkles and gleams with the promise of untold wealth in the faintest of lights, but which crumbles to dust upon the lightest touch.
items.author: Unknown

items.name: Dwarven Holy Symbol
items.description: A dwarven holy symbol in silver; shaped into a flaming war-hammer set against an anvil-shaped backdrop.

items.name: Electrum Bracer
items.description: An archer’s bracer of leather and electrum.
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Electrum Rose
items.description: A detailed rose, with petals and thorns, constructed of silver and electrum.

items.name: Electrum Sheet
items.description: A large (18”x28”), rectangular electrum sheet with ancient writing on it. The writing, if deciphered, is a brief history of a powerful magical item known as the House of Winds, with several clues as to where the item may have been lost fourteen hundred years ago. The House of Winds is described as an ornate mithril helm of legendary power.

items.name: Elephant Tusks
items.description: A collection of six elephant tusks.

items.name: Elven Engraved Combs
items.description: An elegant carved comb of oak, engraved with the name Aethelren and decorated with twin dragons. Elsewhere, a similar comb of ash, engraved with the name Ilthorien and decorated with twin unicorns, can be found.

items.name: Embroidered Gloves
items.description: An embroidered glove set designed for human sized hands, each with jewel chips.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Emerald
items.description: An Emerald is a brilliant green beryl, cleaved along straight box like lines, with rectangular cutting in the finished gem. Emeralds are often connected with health, and so are used ornamentally for such a purpose.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Empty Vial
items.description: An empty vial, just waiting to be filled with something more valuable than itself.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Exceptionally Roguish Hat
items.description: A wide, leather hat, garnished with gold-inlaid thread and exotic bird feathers. Very Vogue.
items.properties:
Putting the hat on causes the wearer to gain 2 CHA and becomes bound to the hat's thrall. The wearer will not give the hat to anyone else willingly. 
Tapping the hat will cause anyone within 10' of the wearer to notice how exceptionally roguish the hat is.
Any Acrobatics/Athletics checks made by the wearer have a 10% chance of causing the hat to fall off. Losing the hat means losing 2 CHA (as well as losing the 2 CHA gained by wearing the hat) because the character never look as good again.
items.author: Lizardmaaaaan

items.name: Eye Agate Gem
items.description: This simple agate gem has translucent circles of white dotted around its surface which bring to mind the image of an eye.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Eye Patch
items.description: An eye patch with a mock eye set in blue sapphire and moonstone.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Fairy Wing Cage
items.description: A small wooden case holding four pairs of fairy wings.

items.name: Fat Cat Statue
items.description: A life sized copper statue of a fat cat with amber eyes that purrs when stroked. Curiously, it does not detect as magic.
items.author: Unknown

items.name: Field Tent
items.description: A large, ornate field tent such as a lord would have, room for 12 persons

items.name: Filthy Bucket
items.description: A filthy bucket, bolted to the floor, ¾ full of urine, containing silver coins, rings and necklaces.

items.name: Fine Cheese
items.description: A 5 inch diameter wheel of fine, aged cheese.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Finely Woven Rug
items.description: A finely made 10’ x 12’ wool floor rug. The center of the rug depicts a scene of siege warfare. A Halfling is being flung over a city wall by a trebuchet.
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Fire Agate Gem
items.description: Fire Agate is the name given to chalcedony which contains thin lines of iridescent goethite. When properly cut, the iridescence displays red, brown, gold, and green hues, and the finest specimens are partly translucent.
items.author: BGII

items.name: Fire Opal
items.description: This Fire Opal is a translucent fiery red colour and is set within a broken brooch. It takes no effort to wedge it out.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Fire Opal Chain
items.description: A fine gold chain set with a fire opal.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Fishing Net
items.description: An unused fishing net made out of spun mammoth hairs.
items.properties: A Small or smaller creature hit by this net is restrained until it is freed. A net has no effect on creatures that are formless, or creatures that are Medium or larger. A creature can use its action to make a DC 10 Strength check, freeing itself or another creature within its reach on a success. Dealing 5 slashing damage to the net (AC 10) also frees the creature without harming it, ending the effect and destroying the net. When you use an action, bonus action, or reaction to attack with a net, you can make only one attack regardless of the number of attacks you can normally make.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Flask Bandolier
items.description: A bandolier holding 8 silver flasks (empty (x3), brandy (x2), acid (x1), ogre blood (x1), gold dust (x1, value of gold: 12gp). (Flasks: 3gp each, bandolier: 5gp, ogre blood (to alchemist): 12gp, acid: 10gp, brandy:

items.name: Flask of Nightmare Ale
items.description: Half-full flask of nightmare ale – 1 sip = 1d4 hours fear check per hour; full measure = 1d4 hours horrifying hallucinations vs DC save for early retirement

items.name: Flask of St. Cuthbert
items.description: A pair of steel flasks, sealed with wax bearing the symbol of St. Cuthbert. (Holy water, 25 gp each)

items.name: Flint & Steel
items.description: A carved steel striker and a piece of shaped flint that allows the user to start a fire.
items.author: PHB

items.name: Fool's Gold
items.description: A handheld water pan with a number of chunks of pyrite in it, otherwise known as "Fool's Gold". You might be able to convince someone that these nuggets are real gold, but not for very long.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Foul Ivory Statue
items.description: A life sized ivory carving of a chicken.

items.name: Fragrant Torches
items.description: A bag containing 1d8 torches infused with pleasant fragrances. This may have been owned by a tanner, to cover the overwhelming stench of tannin that is used in the leathermaking process.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Frost Giant's Necklace
items.description: A frost giant necklace of silver upon which are pierced 17 human-sized hands. All of them appear to be the right hand of their former owner.

items.name: Fulcrum Ring
items.description: A plain, heavy ring of dark metal. It seems occasionally heavy.
items.properties: Mundane in most respects--except when pinched hard from the sides, it will refuse to move. It does not need to be worn for this to take effect.
items.author: /u/gimme_some_sunshine

items.name: Fur Basket
items.description: A wicker basket with a pair of mink furs within.

items.name: Garlic
items.description: A wreath of eight garlic buds.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Garnet Gemstone
items.description: Garnet is a general class of crystals ranging from deep red to violet in colour. a typical cut for this rare isometric gem is 12 to 24 sides, with the very rare 36 sides being known from time to time. it is rumored a 48-sided garnet exists although none have ever been able to track down its location.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Gem
items.description: A teal gem.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Gem of Azurite
items.description: A small Azurite gem. It is opaque and a deep mottled blue in colour.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Giant Temple Candles
items.description: Six giant temple candles. Each is 6’ tall, 1’ thick, and weighs 100 lbs. They are made of fine white wax, rolled in gold dust, and set with emeralds. (320 gps each)

items.name: Giant-King's Necklace
items.description: Giant-King’s platinum necklace with crimson diamond worn by dragon

items.name: Glass of Magnification
items.description: A circle of warped glass attached to a small wooden handle. Strangely, when you look through the glass, everything appears to be bigger. Its not clear what kind of enchantment causes this effect.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Glass Sphere
items.description: A 14 inch diameter sealed glass sphere containing water and an ornamental fish.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Glass Window
items.description: A small colored-glass window pane depicting the crowning of the first king.

items.name: Glittering Glass
items.description: A sparkling handful of raw gems.
items.properties: These convincing rocks are actually made of a river-tumbled glassy stone that is said to form from the aftermath of elemental turmoil.
items.author: /u/gimme_some_sunshine

items.name: Glitternight Dust
items.description: A tiny jar of glitternight dust.
items.properties: Glitternight dust is a narcotic that causes anyone who inhales it to become highly sensitive to any sparkling or shimmering lights. It is mildly addictive.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Glow Stone
items.description: A small green stone that gives off a feint light that's practically imperceptable in anything other than pitch black darkness. It could be used as a marker or a light source in a pinch.
items.properties: Provides dim-light for a 5 foot radius.

items.name: Goat Jerky
items.description: A pound of goat jerky wrapped in a hankerchief.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Gold Bracelet
items.description: A small gold bracelet. It's design is plain so as to be appropriate for anyone.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Gold Bracelet
items.description: A golden bracelet.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Gold Circlet
items.description: A gold circlet set with four aquamarines.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Gold Crown
items.description: A jeweled gold crown of superb quality.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Gold Idol
items.description: A small gold idol.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Gold Jewelry Box
items.description: A solid gold jewelry box with a platinum filigree.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Gold Locket
items.description: A charming golden locket with a painted portrait inside.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Gold Ring
items.description: A small gold ring set with bloodstones.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Gold Statuette
items.description: A small gold statuette of a man, set with rubies.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Golden Arrows
items.description: A quiver of golden arrows, They are devoid of supernatural properties, but despite their unusual composition will perform as normal arrows would.

items.name: Golden Horn
items.description: An eight inch golden horn, likely more of a ceremonial object than of any real value as an instrument.

items.name: Golden Orb
items.description: A roughly beaten golden orb, roughly 10 inches in diameter. The orb is etched with the likeness of an orcish skull with an axe embedded in it. This was used by an orcish chieftain as his “royal orb”.

items.name: Golden Signet Ring
items.description: A golden signet ring, origin unknown.

items.name: Golden Tablet
items.description: A tablet of pure gold, inscribed with the core rites and beliefs of a venerable religion. Careful study of this tablet, however, will reveal subtle – but important – differences between these ancient practices and the current practices of the religion in question.

items.name: Hand Harp
items.description: Silver hand sized harp

items.name: Hand Mirror
items.description: A delicate oval of polished silver frame mirrored glass, its surface worked into flowing patterns that resemble vines caught mid‑bloom.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Harp
items.description: A carved harp of exotic wood with an ivory inlay and zircon gems.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Harpy Feather Fan
items.description: A hand-fan of clipped, black-dyed harpy feathers bound with copper wiring.

items.name: Heart Shaped Token
items.description: A small, heart-shaped token carved out of rose-colored sandstone, holding the mad soul of a princess who was trapped there by a sorcerer many centuries ago. Her body remains in the hidden royal sepulchers of her homeland, perfectly preserved by ancient magic.

items.name: Hell Scented Potpourri
items.description: Potpourri with demon blood – invigorating & entrancing

items.name: Hematite
items.description: A rather dull gray-black hematite gem with the remains of a necklace fasten on its back.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Hemp Rope
items.description: Seven lengths of extremely thick, 30’ long, hemp rope, such as that used for catapults.

items.name: Hero Dolls
items.description: These start getting made after the party does something particularly heroic. Little cloth dolls that look like party members, when squeezed, the caster spouts illusionary flames, the cleric spouts prayers "Praise Avandra!", the fighter has kung-fu action where he swings his sword.

items.name: Hollow Glass Sphere
items.description: A hollow glass sphere of surprising proportions – nearly three meters across. If it is broken those nearby will catch the barest scent of alien perfumes, hinting at strange lands belonging to the ancient time when the sphere was first forged and air trapped within it.

items.name: Holy Bones
items.description: A reliquary containing the bones of an ancient holy man
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Holy Ice Symbol
items.description: An ornate block of ice carved into an ancient holy symbol. The carving has a subtle taint of magic to it, but it's not exactly clear what prevents it from melting.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Holy Symbol
items.description: The holy symbol of a god long thought dead and gone.

items.name: Honey
items.description: A quart of honey in a small glass bottle.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Hope Chest
items.description: A delicately carved hope chest of polished cherry wood. The box contains nothing but a remarkably fine, gray sand drawn from some unknown locale. Beneath the new moon, this sand glows a faint blue.
items.author: Unknown

items.name: Horn Coral Gem
items.description: Horn Coral, which is also called night coral, is a deep black coral, similar to angel's skin save for its solid color. It is incredibly difficult to work with, and is used in jewelry as a polished twig or branch of material, or is cut cabochon.
items.author: BGII

items.name: Inhalation Herbs & Essences
items.description: Inhalation herbs & essences provide natural healing remedies for all manner of symptoms such as headaches, colds and flu.

items.name: Ink
items.description: A vial of black ink, for use with a quill.
items.properties: When unstoppered underwater, this item causes an inky cloud to fill a 10′ cubic area which lasts for the duration of the room. It effectively renders all characters and monsters in the area obscured from ranged attacks.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Iol Gem
items.description: Iol is actually short for Iolite (cordierite), although a common nickname is "violet stone" even though its overall hue is usually blue. Iols are usually cut into faceted gems to best display the stone's color change as it is viewed from different directions. Small, cut iols can be clear, but larger specimens usually contain silky inclusions of another substance such as hemitite crystals, which give the same rich golden flash of color as in sunstones.
items.author: BGII

items.name: Iron Buckle
items.description: An iron belt buckle that's beginning to rust.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Iron Earring
items.description: An iron earring. Missing it's twin.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Iron Nail
items.description: A large iron nail, useful for fixing things together.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Iron Spike
items.description: A large iron spike, useful for fixing heavy items together.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Iron Torc
items.description: An iron bracelet with six small silver figurines: A hare, a horse, a spear, a wolf’s head, a simple circle, and an oak tree.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Ivory Dress
items.description: A lovely ivory-colored dress of silk with flowing sleeves. The dress has tiny pearls sewn at the neckline.

items.name: Ivory Drinking Horn
items.description: A bejeweled ivory drinking horn with gold filigree.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Ivory Mice
items.description: A small sack containing 32 carved ivory mice

items.name: Ivory Peg Leg
items.description: Carved from a single, sweeping piece of aged whale ivory, the prosthetic has a smooth, organic texture. The material’s natural grain is akin to soft waves of cream, honey, and pale grey.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Ivory Statuette
items.description: A carved sculpture of jungle animals on an ivory tusk.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Jacinth
items.description: A transparent fiery orange gem variety of Zircon.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Jade Buttons
items.description: A small collection of antique Jade buttons.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Jade Fountain
items.description: A decorative fountain, crafted elegantly from a single block of jade and decorated with gold leaf, in which the water flows in the wrong direction.

items.name: Jade Game Board
items.description: An ornate game board made of jade, with 40 solid gold playing pieces.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Jade Pendant
items.description: A small, white jade pendant without necklace. The pendant depicts a unicorn rampant with a cracked back leg.

items.name: Jade Statue
items.description: A Weather-worn jade statue depicting a desert beast known only to the people of the far south.

items.name: Jade Telescope
items.description: A telescope of jade and banded with bloodstone. A character looking through the telescope sees not the world around them, but a strange, alien panorama which – nonetheless – follows the motions of the telescope.

items.name: Jar o' Eyeballs
items.description: A jar containing six eyeballs (2 human, 1 goblin, 1 ogre, 1 worg, and 1 hawk) in a clear liquid.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Jasper Gem
items.description: Jasper is an opaque quartz found in reds, browns, and blacks. Very rare specimens are blue or have bands of blue against the other colours. Jasper can be crushed and used in making potions and magical devices which protect against poison.
items.author: Baldur's Gate

items.name: Jerky
items.description: A small satchel containing half a pound of jerked meat. It has a distinctly Goblin-like aroma that might raise suspicion to the picky eater.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Jet Brooch
items.description: A deep black brooch set with a Jet gemstone. Rumor suggests a brooch of this nature helps prevent the evil eye.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Jewel Encrusted Sarcophagus
items.description: Jewel encrusted sarcophagus – mummy inside

items.name: Jewel Wood
items.description: A 6’ stack of 1” x 8” x 12’ planks of rare, scented jewel wood

items.name: Jeweled Anklet
items.description: A jeweled anklet.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Keg o' Nails
items.description: A 35 pound keg of iron nails.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: King's Tears
items.description: King's Tears are very rare and are sometimes called frozen tears. Clear, teardrop-shaped, smooth surfaced, and totally unbreakable so far by any means. These stones are said to be the crystallized tears of long-dead necromancer kings. In each gem can be seen that which the weeping king loved long ago. Their true nature is unknown but suffice it to say that sages prize these gems above all others
items.author: BGII

items.name: Knee Breeches
items.description: A pair of bear fur knee breeches, slightly worn from having been used when horse riding.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Lapis Lazuli Gem
items.description: A gem of lapis lazuli, dark blue in colour with light yellow flecks.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Large Bronze Bell
items.description: A large (36” diameter) bronze bell.

items.name: Large Pile of Coal
items.description: A large pile of coal.
items.properties: If properly inspected, the party will find two small, rough diamonds hidden near the bottom of the pile.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Large Snow Globe
items.description: A large snow globe, with a study base of polished oak, depicting a small farmhouse in the midst of a forest clearing. Shaking the globe causes the snow to gently fall, and as it does miniature figures exit the house and begin performing chores about the farmyard. The figures return to the house as the last flake falls.

items.name: Lava Rocks
items.description: Rocks stuffed with lava

items.name: Lead Coins
items.description: A satchel of gold painted lead coins.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Leather Bag of Dragon Scales
items.description: A leather bag containing 6 green dragon scales (young adult).

items.name: Leather Ball
items.description: A leather ball stuffed with chicken feathers. On a DC 15 peception check the player can find an electrum ring amongst the feathers.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Leather Quiver
items.description: A quiver shaped from thick, well‑oiled hide. Its cylindrical body is firm enough to protect arrows yet supple enough to flex slightly with movement.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Leather Satchel
items.description: A satchel crafted from thick, full‑grain hide.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Leviathan Organ
items.description: Pulsating organ of leviathan (is sack/cloth)

items.name: Lich Skull
items.description: Fossilized skull of lich-arcane power source

items.name: Little Riding Hood
items.description: A bright red hooded cape sized for a child, spattered with dried blood.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Lost Diamond
items.description: A sizeable cut diamond with bluish tint.
items.properties: Whenever this diamond is sought, it has a DC 12 to be found. If it is not found, it is in the ethereal plane, and remains there for 30 minutes until reappearing.
items.author: /u/gimme_some_sunshine

items.name: Lynx Eye Gem
items.description: Lynx eye is a special type of labradorite. It is pale to dark grey and has patches of coloured reflections. This "flash" is most commonly blue but can be of all shades. "Green Flash" labradorite is called Lynx Eye in the local regions.
items.author: Baldur's Gate

items.name: Lynx Eye Gem
items.description: Lynx eye is a specific type of labradorite (a feldspar gemstone). Labradorite as a class of stones is pale to dark gray and has patches of colored reflections. This "flash" is most commonly blue but can be of all shades. "Green Flash" labradorite is called lynx eye in the Realms.
items.author: Baldur's Gate II

items.name: Malachite Bracelet
items.description: A thin malachite bracelet with a silver clasp.

items.name: Malachite Gem
items.description: A large malachite gem. It is striated light and dark green across its polished surface.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Malivar's Wardrobe
items.description: A large bronze wardrobe, banded in steel, which contains Violet Fungi (hp 15) and a human body with rotting noble’s clothing, a rusty dagger, and a thin platinum bracelet set with a moonstone.

items.name: Man Mask
items.description: A mask carved to look like the face of a man, but which seems to have been fitted to be worn by something with a sharp angled face.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Manticora Branding Iron
items.description: A mithril-headed branding-iron bearing the sigil of the Manticora Trading House.

items.name: Mantle Set
items.description: An embroidered silk and velvet mantle set with numerous moonstones.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Masquerade Mask
items.description: A masquerade mask crafted of leather and peacock feathers.

items.name: Masterpiece Painting
items.description: An old painting, a lot treasure by a painter of some renoun.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Masterwork Gaming Darts
items.description: With an elegant hinged case of black onyx, the characters find a set of masterwork gaming darts. Although useless for combat, the darts will give a +2 skill check bonus to anyone using them to play a game of darts (due to their superb balance and construction).

items.name: Matroshka Seeds
items.description: Within a wooden box carved with pastoral scenes lies a leather purse, and within the purse are a handful of seeds. If these seeds are planted, they will take root and grow into plants of unnatural shape, hue, and life unlike anything seen upon this world, and operating by utterly alien principles.

items.name: Medicinal Herbs
items.description: A cabinet containing 24 glass jars of various medicinal herbs

items.name: Milk Chocolate
items.description: Sometimes, nothing but chocolate will do, even if it's this inexpensive and slightly chalky variety.
items.author: Fable II

items.name: Mineral Oil
items.description: 2 oz bottle of mineral oil

items.name: Minting Tools
items.description: A set of dies and hammers for minting the king's coinage.

items.name: Mistletoe
items.description: A handful (D6) of mistletoe sprigs.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Moonbar Gemstone
items.description: Moonbar is a pearly white, opaque gemstone, usually pale blue with green and gold mottling. Related in type to fire and black opals, but is only slightly more common.
items.author: BGII

items.name: Moonstone
items.description: Moonstone is an opaque, white feldspar gem polished to a bluish sheen. Old legends say that the sight of a moonstone would cause a lycanthrope to revert to his animal form. Whether or not this is true is unknown as anyone close enough to find out apparently hasn't lived to tell the tale. However moonstones have been used in spells that effect this particular curse.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Moonstone Sheath
items.description: A dagger sheath of bronze, set with a small moonstone.
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Moss Agate Gem
items.description: A beautiful moss agate gem. It is a translucent pink with a mossy gray texture.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Mudbrick Chocolate
items.description: Well, it's brown, but that doesn't necessarily make it chocolate. Still, at least its sweet. In an unusual and repugnant way.
items.author: Fable II

items.name: Music Box
items.description: An ornate golden music box.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Mysterious Ivory Figurine
items.description: An age-worn ivory figurine, which, nonetheless, bears an uncanny resemblance to a young woman the characters have just met.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Navigational Calculator
items.description: A gear-driven ships navigational calculator enclosed in a jewelwood box.

items.name: Nymph Statuette
items.description: A foot-high bronze statuette of a pair of entwined nymphs, dancing.

items.name: Obsidian Dolphin
items.description: An obsidian figurine of a dolphin which is always wet to the touch.

items.name: Obsidian Gem
items.description: A small opaque black gem.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Obsidian Statuette
items.description: An obsidian statuette of a demon with a golden inlay and fittings.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Oily Rags
items.description: Three oily rags in an old wicker basket.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Old Boot
items.description: An old boot filled with chunks/flakes of silver-bearing quartz ore.

items.name: Old Hat
items.description: A ragged old hat with a moth eaten brim.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Old Saddlebag
items.description: A rotten saddlebag with a few coins spilling out. The copper coins have some verdigris and the silver coins are badly tarnished.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Old Wheelbarrow
items.description: A rotting wheelbarrow holding a large number of burned out torches.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Onyx Gemstone
items.description: This gemstone has opaque bands of black and white across it's surface.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Opal
items.description: A translucent pale blue Opal with green and golden mottling.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Ornate Abacus
items.description: An abacus with counting beads made of ivory, silver, gold, and vitrified eye balls.
items.author: Unknown

items.name: Ornate Axe Head
items.description: An unhafted axe head of exceptional craftsmanship. It’s faces are inlaid with a faience scene showing a crowd of human villagers throwing a Halfling down a well.
items.properties: 1d6 Slashing - Simple - Light, Thrown - Range: 20/60

items.name: Ornate Longsword
items.description: This longsword seems to have been made more for show than for use. It is silver-plated steel and has a jet gemstone set inside the hilt.
items.properties: 1d8 Slashing - Versatile (1d10)
items.author: DMG

items.name: Ornate Smoking Pipe
items.description: An ivory and copper smoking pipe with stale tobacco inside.

items.name: Ornate Wooden Leg
items.description: A wooden leg, carved to appear as a standing leopard with green agate eyes. (Agates: 4gp each; the whole leg, with eyes: 10gp)

items.name: Parchment
items.description: A spare bit of parchment.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Pearl
items.description: Pearls consist of layers of aragonite agonizingly formed around a bit of grit or other irritant inside oysters and other mollusks. The resulting pearl has a rich, deep luster. Most of the pearls in the realms are white, however there are varieties that are much more rare such as rainbow and black.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Pearl Necklace
items.description: A necklace string of small pink pearls.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Peridot Gemstone
items.description: A circular Peridot of rich green colouring with milky inclusions.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Phoenix Egg
items.description: "Phoenix Egg" from a peddler in the City of Brass. After consulting with a few scholars, he later found that (at least in my world lore) Phoenixes are born of primal energy and not hatched, and that he had in fact purchased a very large jar of Alchemist's Fire.

items.name: Pick Axe
items.description: A straight wooden handle with a curved iron pick useful for breaking up rocky surfaces or hard earth. It would not make for an effecitve weapon, but without the head the handle would make for a rudimentary club.
items.properties: 1d4 Bludgeoning - Simple - Light
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Pickle
items.description: A single pickle wrapped in an oily paper bag. It has a strong distinct smell, but otherwise seems like a normal pickle.
items.author: Unknown

items.name: Piglet
items.description: A piglet.

items.name: Platinum Bracelet
items.description: A platinum bracelet set with a sapphire.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Platinum Ring
items.description: A jeweled platinum ring.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Playing Cards
items.description: A classic 52 card set of playing cards.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Porcelain Discs
items.description: One hundred and sixteen 3” white porcelain discs, each has a 1 ounce knob of electrum embedded in its center

items.name: Potpourri
items.description: A fragrant bowl of potpourri.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Priest Skeleton
items.description: A human skeleton in rotted priest’s robes wearing a ring and necklace. (Electrum ring: 4gp Silver necklace: 3gp)

items.name: Prism's Copper Goblin
items.description: A goblin skull that has been dipped in molten copper. (1gp)

items.name: Quicksilver Surprise
items.description: In a worn and decaying wall of mud bricks, a single black brick – polished and perfectly preserved – stands out in stark contrast. If the brick is pried out and broken open, it will reveal a quicksilver core.

items.name: Rabbit's Foot
items.description: A lucky rabbit’s foot which hangs from a golden chain. Although separated from the rest of the rabbit, the foot magically lives on: It will respond to touch, bleed if injured, and so forth.

items.name: Raisins
items.description: Half a tin of raisins.
items.properties: Could be considered a trail ration, if your party has low standards.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Random Monster Taxidermy
items.description: Random monster taxidermy

items.name: Raven Feather Fans
items.description: A pair of pole mounted fans made of giant raven feathers

items.name: Raven Statue
items.description: A life-size basalt statue of a raven.

items.name: Replica Castle
items.description: A 3’ square replica of a castle, in wood, complete with ramparts and miniature ballistae and toy soldiers. Scribbled in some spots are notes written in draconic that suggest a plan to assault the castle (“Kill guard here first”, “Murder holes overhead”, Fireball this area”, etc…)

items.name: Reversible Robes
items.description: Reversible, finely crafted robes

items.name: Rhodochrosite Gem
items.description: This rhodochrosite gem is a light pink colour and shaped to resemble a small heart.
items.author: DMG

items.name: River Stone
items.description: A stone that has been worn down to a smooth finish. Probably from a river bed.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Rogue Stone
items.description: A small, shifting, rainbow coloured, irridecent gemstone. The fluid shades of colour appear almost liquid under normal sunlight, it is truly a beautiful sight to behold. Rogue stones are extremely rare and are used for the gemjump spell, hence one of the most sought after gems in the Realms.
items.author: BGII

items.name: Ruby
items.description: Ruby is a pink to blood-red colored gemstone, a variety of the mineral corundum.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Rusty Horseshoe
items.description: An old rusty horseshoe, the metal may be worth something.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Sack of Flower Bulbs
items.description: A sack of prized flower bulbs

items.name: Sarcophagus
items.description: A painted gold child's sarcophagus. It is empty, but itself valuable.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Sardonyx Gemstone
items.description: Bands of white-yellow sard cross the surface of this dark onyx gemstone.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Satyr Pipes
items.description: Silver pan/satyr pipes/flute

items.name: Sausages
items.description: Package of d6 sausages

items.name: Saw
items.description: A simple saw blade forged from darkened iron that bears the marks of age: patches of oxidation, faint pitting, and the soft sheen that comes only from years of sharpening and use.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Scroll Case
items.description: A long, cylindrical container made from smooth wood, designed to shield delicate parchment from weather, wear, and wandering hands.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Scroll Case
items.description: Nigh-indestructible scroll case – leviathan ivory, jewel encrusted, demon paintings on side – scraps of scroll inside

items.name: Sea Shell Coil
items.description: A 40’ coil of rare sea shells strung on a silken cord

items.name: Seaglass Earring
items.description: A single, elegant seaglass colored earring made of clear glasslike material. Its exact shape changes slowly over time, shifting from one watery artful shape to another.
items.properties: The attuned bearer of this earring may cast the "Control Water" spell once per day, using Charisma as their modifier. The bearer may also take an aqueous form once per day, becoming immune to nonmagical damage, gaining a swim speed of 60 ft, and may effuse through pinhole openings for up to 1 minute.
items.author: /u/gimme_some_sunshine

items.name: Set of Golden Cups
items.description: A set of golden cups, each set with emeralds.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Shandon Gem
items.description: Shandon is another name for natrolite; its slender, colorless crystals yield tiny faceted gems used often in veils and robes in order to capture the beading effect of water glistening upon the material.
items.author: BGII

items.name: Sharpening Sheath
items.description: A dagger sheath of hardened leather, set with a number of cheap decorative stones. Any dagger kept within this sheath is automatically sharpened as if it were a fresh blade.
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Silk Handkerchief
items.description: This silk handkerchief is embroidered with a pale pink pattern.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Silk Robe
items.description: A long silk robe with golden embroidery.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Silver and Gold Brooch
items.description: A simple but finely made silver and gold brooch.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Silver Brooch
items.description: A silver brooch depicting a mage’s tower. (This could be a pass for magical wards at the mage’s tower, at the DM’s discretion.)

items.name: Silver Bullets
items.description: A pouch filled with 13 silver sling bullets. Each bullet is engraved with the holy symbol of Pelor.
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Silver Chalice
items.description: A finely made silver chalice etched in arcane symbols. An arcane check will find no trace of magic, however, and it may be that these are simply aesthetic.
items.author: Unknown

items.name: Silver Chalice
items.description: A silver chalice set with moonstones.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Silver Ewer
items.description: A large jug with a wide mouth coated in silver.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Silver Hand Mirror
items.description: A silver hand mirror with mother-of-pearl backing.

items.name: Silver Necklace
items.description: This silver necklace has a gemstone pendant.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Silver Ore
items.description: A large chunk of raw silver ore.

items.name: Silver Ring
items.description: A simple silver ring that bears no inscription or identifying marks on it's surface.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Silver Spoons
items.description: A set of 8 silver spoons.

items.name: Silver Statuettes
items.description: A set of five small silver statuettes (each about 2” tall) consisting of a cat, an owl, a falcon, a horse and a griffon.

items.name: Silver-tipped Quill
items.description: A silver-tipped quill with an elaborate white feather.
items.author: Unknown

items.name: Six Fingered Gloves
items.description: Two six-fingered gloves, along with a matching seven-fingered glove. The set is made of supple black leather, and stitched with fine, silver thread.

items.name: Skeleton Key
items.description: A single, platinum skeleton-key on a platinum ring. The key is finely crafted, with a delicate design etched in elvish characters along the length and across the bow.

items.name: Skull Idol
items.description: Gold dipped idol of several skulls

items.name: Skydrop Gem
items.description: Skydrop is the common name given to clear or lightly colored tektite material; fragments of glass of celestial (meteoric) origin, found in the vast shifting sands of Anauroch and other deserts.
items.author: BGII

items.name: Small Mirror
items.description: A slightly dirty mirror set in a painted wooden frame.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Smoking Box
items.description: A long, narrow wooden box containing forty, ½ lb rolls of quality smoking leaf.

items.name: Smoking Pipe
items.description: A six foot long smoking pipe made of ivory, possibly a narwhal horn, carved to look like a twisting serpent.

items.name: Snail Dye
items.description: A 1 quart jar of rare purple snail dye.
items.properties: Snail dye tastes of snails.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Snow Serpent Stockings
items.description: Four pairs of snow serpent fur felt stockings

items.name: Soap
items.description: Some fresh, waxy soap. It smells faintly of lavender.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Sphene Gem
items.description: Sphene is a soft, brittle gemstone (and, like scapra, easily worked by unskilled cutters) of various yellow to green shades, the most prized of these being a fine emerald green.
items.author: BGII

items.name: Spinel Necklace
items.description: A spun leather necklace of deep green Spinel beads.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Star Diopside Gem
items.description: Star Diopside is the most prized form of a hard, durable gemstone that is rarely found in attractive colours. It is usually too dark for beauty, however mountain and streambed-pebble crystals of a pale green hue make attractive stones such as diopside. When a gem is found that is darker green it can be cut in such a fashion so to produce four- or six-rayed stars.
items.author: BGII

items.name: Star Rose Quartz
items.description: This gemstone is a polished pink sphere. When viewed at a specific angle with a source of light an asterism (star-effect) is visible across it's surface.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Star Ruby
items.description: A translucent ruby with a white star-shaped center.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Star Sapphire
items.description: Star Sapphire is a precious variation of the sapphire, however is more translucent, with a white star highlighted in its center. A star sapphire has been known to ornament devices which protect against magic.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Steel Chain
items.description: A steel chain measuring 1 foot long.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Steel Lockbox
items.description: A small metal chest with a lock, crafted from polished steel.
items.properties: It comes provided with a key, and it takes a DC 15 Dexterity check to pick the lock with thieves' tools.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Steel Spiked Gauntlets
items.description: A pair of blue enameled steel spiked gauntlets. The palms of both gauntlets are designed to display the Cambersome family crest, a stylized ‘C’ shaped into the likeness of a coiled serpent.

items.name: Stone of Myr'Bregothil
items.description: It is said this gem was once imbued with the power to prevent those who died from passing over to the next realm. Whether it is true or not, it remains extremely valuable.
items.author: Fable II

items.name: Storm Giant Coins
items.description: Thirty storm giant minted gold coins, each is the size of a dinner plate and weighs 17 lbs. The image stuck on the coins shows a giant hand flicking a human off a table.

items.name: Straw Broom
items.description: A straw broom

items.name: Stuffed Falcon
items.description: A stuffed falcon, tattered with age, with black onyx eyes. (Onyx value: 5gp each)

items.name: Sun Gem
items.description: This round and polished stone glows with a fierce light and seems to dispel the shadows around you.
items.properties: Properties of a torch.
items.author: BGII

items.name: Sunrod Quiver
items.description: A short quiver holding 3 sunrods.

items.name: Sunstone Gem
items.description: Sunstone is a feldspar jem, closely related to moonstone, and more properly known as oligoclase. Sunstone can be colorless or faintly greenish and of facet grade, but most common by far is its softer (cabochon) variety. This yields gemstones that have bright red or orange spangles (minute crystals) suspended in a nearly colorless background in a parallel fashion, giving the whole a rich golden or redish brown color.
items.author: BGII

items.name: Tapestry
items.description: A large, well-made tapestry depicting a local duke.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Tasty Cake
items.description: A well-sealed cake box with intact cake

items.name: Tattoo Kit
items.description: Ritualistic tattooing kit

items.name: Tchazar Gem
items.description: Tchazar is the common name given to aragonite, a straw-yellow gemstone found in elongated, prism-shaped crystal form. It is soft and fragile, and requires skilled cutting to yield faceted gems..
items.author: BGII

items.name: Teak Mask
items.description: A cracked mask of teak wood, colored in (chipped) blue and red paint depicting the face of a fairy (4sp)

items.name: The Diamond of Sorrow
items.description: This invaluable gem was once a decorative allure grown and used by a mimic. A rumor persists that the diamond got it's name due to an adventurer who befriended, and then eventually betrayed, the mimic that created it.
items.author: Fable II

items.name: Thunderstone Amulet
items.description: A small chain with flint stone in the shape of a triangle hanging from it. Popular tradition states that this is a "Thunderstone", a rock that has fallen from the sky during a storm. The fact that is resembles a primitive axe head, however, may fall upon deaf ears.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Tiger Eye Gem
items.description: Translucent brown with a bright golden center.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Tigerseye Ring
items.description: You find a barrel filled with broken crockery. Near the bottom is a mouse nest in which, amidst the tangled mouse fur, lays a silver ring set with a polished tigerseye.

items.name: Tin Cup
items.description: A tin drinking cup.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Tinderbox
items.description: A full tinderbox.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Tobacco
items.description: A small amount of tobacco wrapped in a large soft leaf.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Tobacco Cask
items.description: A small cedar cask of dwarven pipe tobacco.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Top Secret Battle Monkeys
items.description: Box of ‘Top Secret Battle Monkeys’

items.name: Topaz
items.description: A yellow facet cut Topaz gemstone.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Totem Pole
items.description: A pinewood totem pole of the northern barbarians, bearing six faces (from top to bottom): a hawk, a demon, an elk, a man, a fox, and a white dragon. The hawk has a silver feather on the left side of its face (8gp), the demon has a gold nose-ring (6gp), the elk has copper antlers (4gp), the man has electrum eyes (3gp each), the fox has a black onyx nose (15gp), and the dragon has ivory teeth (30 teeth worth 1gp each). The pole is fifteen feet tall and weighs 200 pounds. (4.57m, 90.7kg)

items.name: Tourmaline Chain
items.description: A delicate silver chain set with a tourmaline.

items.name: Tourmaline Gemstone
items.description: A multi colored rectangular Tourmaline gemstone.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Triple Harness
items.description: A leather harness bearing three short quivers (sized for quarrels, rather than arrows). The first holds a dozen red-fletched quarrels, the second a dozen green fletched quarrels, and the third has a dozen white fletched quarrels.

items.name: Troglodyte Egg
items.description: A brown and red flecked egg, about the size of a loaf of bread, that gives off a rancid scent.

items.name: Troll Oboe
items.description: An oboe-like musical instrument made from a troll’s femur.

items.name: Turquoise Gem
items.description: Turquoise is an opaque aqua stone with darker mottling, and is found in the more arid reaches of the Realms. Horsemen will often place a sliver of this stone in a horse's harness as a sign of good luck.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Two-Sided Die
items.description: This perculiar dice is made out of copper and has two sides. Engraved on one side is the portrait of a long forgotten ruler, on the other is an ornate two headed chimera. Useful for making decisions. Doesn't roll well.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Uncut Diamond
items.description: An uncut chunk of raw diamond. It is easily the size of a dwarf’s fist and is likely worth a substantial sum to the right jewel maker.

items.name: Underworld Currency
items.description: Underworld Currency – lead coins; purple rocks/crystals, fairy dust, dragon scales, dna globules (rocks/capsules with runic understanding of specific creatures), tally bones, soul traps/crystals

items.name: Unfinished Zircon Gem
items.description: This gemstone has not yet been finished, but even in its unpolished state it's bright cyan gleam is arresting to the eye.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Unicorn Pipes
items.description: A set of panpipes carved from the bones of a unicorn. When played, they do not make the slightest sound.

items.name: Unreadable Note
items.description: A paper note that's been left on a damp floor. It's completely illegible.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Unusable Scroll
items.description: A tattered, and sadly unusable, scroll fragment, inscribed with a spell unknown to any living mage.

items.name: Usk Brandy
items.description: A five gallon cask of usk brandy.

items.name: Vials of Oil
items.description: Seventy-three clay vials of oil (1 pint each).

items.name: Walking Stick
items.description: A wooden walking stick.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: War Mask
items.description: This mask has been painted gold and appears to be a ceremonial mask worn to battle.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Warning Box
items.description: Box with runic markings for destroy/to be destroyed containing cursed object

items.name: Wasplight Lantern
items.description: A dozen glow wasps in a round wire cage with handle. Equal to a torch light at night. Require food and water daily.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Water Opal
items.description: Water Opal is a colourless, clear opal with a play of colour. It is rare and valuable in the Realms, where it is used in scrying devices.
items.author: BGII

items.name: Waterstar Gem
items.description: Waterstar is also called achroite or colourless tourmaline and is rare in the Realms. This stone is riddled with flaws and inclusions and hence only a small portion is fit for cutting.
items.author: BGII

items.name: Weapon Cabinet
items.description: A weapons cabinet, unlocked and immovable, containing: 12 score arrows (1gp/score), 40 javelins (1gp each), 120 crossbow bolts (1sp/each), and a short bow (30gp).

items.name: Weight Training Equipment
items.description: The party finds a complete set of bronze and carved stone weight training equipment issued to the 4th army of some Ancient Empire. There is an inscription in one of the weights that reads "Dost thou even lift, brother?"
items.author: Unknown

items.name: Weighted Die (6 Sided)
items.description: A weighted dice.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Wellwizard's Teacups
items.description: A pair of elegantly decorated teacups that always feel warm to the touch. If filled with any liquid, it will somehow seep through invisible cracks in the cup.
items.properties: When held, the teacups will fill with hot, pleasant tea. If a pleasant conversation ensues, the teacups will refill up to three times. If someone holding the cups tells a lie, the tea will seep through invisible cracks.
items.author: /u/gimme_some_sunshine

items.name: Whalebone Scrimshaw
items.description: An elaborate, whalebone scrimshaw carving of intertwined orbs, each showing the legend of creation story of one of the seven civilized religions, roughly 10” in diameter.

items.name: Whistle
items.description: A small wooden whistle.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: White Ivory Cane
items.description: A cane of the purest white ivory, decorated with ruins unknown to modern scholars, and topped with a handle of polished amber. Trapped within the amber is a strange creature unlike any the PCs have ever seen before.

items.name: White Marble Ball
items.description: A small ball of white marble – roughly three inches across – which hovers in the air until it is touched or disturbed, at which point it falls to the floor and ceases to exhibit any supernatural properties.

items.name: Wolf Pelt
items.description: A grey and white wolf pelt.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Wolfsbane
items.description: D8 springs of wolfsbane

items.name: Wooden Board
items.description: A weather worn wooden board, inscribed with patterns which make it clear that it was once used for a game whose rules have long since been lost to time.

items.name: Wooden Plate
items.description: A carved wooden plate.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Wooden Spike
items.description: A long wooden spike, used to fix soft items together or kill vampires while they sleep.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Wooden Wind Chimes
items.description: A set of wooden wind chimes which plays a different tune depending upon the direction of the wind which disturbs it.

items.name: Wormscrape
items.description: A narcotic made from the petal of a wormrose flower.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Wrought Iron Sign
items.description: A large, wrought-iron sign crafted to read: “Beware of Wyvern” in a bold script.

items.name: Yellow Sapphire
items.description: A transparent fiery yellow or yellow· green Sapphire.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Yggdrasil Leaf
items.description: A leaf from the great tree Yggdrasil.

items.name: Ziose Gemstone
items.description: Ziose is the name given by sages to a particular facet-grade variety of ziosite; a rare mineral that yields cut stones that flash three vivid hues depending on how the light catches them; purple, blue, and red, or purple, green, and red. Very large (fist- or foot-sized) gems are found and are prized for use in pendants and brooches.
items.author: BGII

items.name: Zircon Gemstone
items.description: Zircon is a brownish crystal found in igneous (volcanic) rocks. Zircon attains its pale blue shade with heating and cutting (usually facet-cut).
items.author: SRD

items.name: Zombie Dust
items.description: A small, brown glass jar, sealed with wax, with a gray dust inside. A white label is affixed to the jar, and reads: “Zombie Dust” in a shaky script. (It is zombie dust.)

items.name: 1d20 Ammunition +1
items.description: You have a bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this piece of magic ammunition. The bonus is determined by the rarity of the ammunition. Once it hit a target, the ammunition is no longer magical. Value listed is for individual units.
items.author: DMG

items.name: 1d20 Ammunition +2
items.description: You have a bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this piece of magic ammunition. The bonus is determined by the rarity of the ammunition. Once it hit a target, the ammunition is no longer magical. Value listed is for individual units.
items.author: DMG

items.name: 1d20 Ammunition +3
items.description: You have a bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this piece of magic ammunition. The bonus is determined by the rarity of the ammunition. Once it hit a target, the ammunition is no longer magical. Value listed is for individual units.
items.author: DMG

items.name: 2d4 + 2 Arrows of Slaying
items.description: An arrow of slaying is a magic weapon meant to slay a particular kind of creature. Some are more focused than others; for example, there are both arrows of dragon slaying and arrows of blue dragon slaying. If a creature belonging to the type, race, or group associated with an arrow of slaying takes damage from the arrow, the creature must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking an extra 6d10 piercing damage on a failed save, or half as much extra damage on a successful one. Once an arrow of slaying deals its extra damage to a creature, it becomes a nonmagical arrow. Other types of magic ammunition of this kind exist, such as bolts of slaying meant for a crossbow, though arrows are most common. Value listed is for each arrow.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Adjatha the Drinker
items.description: This blade belonged to Dabbar, a long dead servant of Bhaal that exercised control over his minions in the most brutal of ways. In addition to strengthening the mind against the guile of others, the sword absorbs life energy from an opponent with each successful hit, healing the user. Dabbar considered it a failure of his officers if he returned from battle in less than perfect health, and as the rest of the company watched, he would administer beatings until fully healed.
items.properties:
1d8+2 Slashing - Versatile (1d10+2)
Heals the wielder 1 hit point every time it hits the target. Makes wielder immune to charm and domination status effects.
items.author: Baldur's Gate II

items.name: Albruin
items.description: Basalin was a large man, rumored, far from his hearing, to be a werebear. He long wielded the bastard sword Albruin in the protection of his village, slaying giant spiders that plagued the area. The sword protected him from their poison and also allowed him to see invisible Red Wizards who controlled some of the more fantastic variants. The reason for their enmity is unknown.
items.properties:
2d4+3 Slashing - Versatile (2d6+2)
Renders user immune to poison.
Can detect invisibility once per day.
items.author: Baldur's Gate II

items.name: Ancient Sword
items.description: A used and slightly rusted double-bladed sword.
items.properties: 1d4 Piercing - Finesse, Light
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Arbalest
items.description: A large arbalest/bolt thrower. It is disassembled and crated for shipping. It requires four strong men to lift. When reassembled, it hurls a 5’ bolt for 2d12 damage.
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Axe of Blood
items.properties: crimson red axe that deals 1d6 slashing damage and 1d6 bludgeoning damage. Each hit restores +1 hp to wielding regardless of damage dealt

items.name: Bag of Angel Feathers
items.description: 1d6 angel feathers aura of good; razor sharp; stronger than steel (can be used as weapon like dagger)
items.properties: 1d4 Piercing - Finesse, Light, Range, Thrown - 20/60
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Balering, the Sword of Balance
items.description: A long steel blade with an amber edge and lustrous golden hilt. When first discovered, the blade is without detail, but is filled with runes as members of other races volunteer their blood as tribute to the blade's cause.
items.properties: 1d8, plus an additional 1d8 radiant damage to Dragons, Garou, and Spiders for each rune that appears on the blade. The blade is adorned with a rune for every 3 different races that willingly shed their blood on the sword.
items.author: /u/gimme_some_sunshine

items.name: Ballistic Fist Hammer
items.description: Ballistic Fist Hammer (Hammer with each side acting as ballistic fists from Fallout series)
items.properties: Damage? Will determine cost.
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Banshee Spirit Dagger
items.description:
Despite appearing to be a normal dagger, even those not able to recognise the presence of magic can tell that there is something imbued in the unassuming metal hilt and blade.

When appraised it transpires that this blade was buried with a banshee and it's spirit has somehow been absorbed. Now whomever uses the dagger carries the risk that its spirit will be unleashed.
items.properties: On a critical hit, it'll scream like her. It hasn't happened yet, but I imagine it'll either force the target to make a will save or be feared, or possibly drop to zero hit points.
items.author: /u/Silanoch

items.name: Battleaxe
items.description: A smooth wooden shaft topped with a large, curved steel head.
items.properties: 1d8 Slashing - (Versatile 1d10)
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Berserker Axe
items.description: You gain +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. In addition, while you are attuned to this weapon your hit point maximum increased by 1 for each level you have attained.
items.properties:
Cursed. 
See DMG page 155.
items.author: DMG

items.name: Blink Dagger
items.description: Twice per day, whomever users this dagger can instantly teleport up to 30 ft in any direction. Cannot be used if you were attacked since your last turn.
items.properties: 1d4+2 Piercing | Finesse, Light

items.name: Bloodgaze, Champion of Vingaret
items.description: This greatsword belongs to the current mortal champion of Vingaret, the goddess of vengeance.
items.properties: Once per day, the attuned champion can choose to have one attack with Bloodgaze deal an extra 1D10 damage to the target if the target was the last creature to attack the champion. This damage increases to 2D10 when the champion reaches 7th level and to 3D10 when the champion reaches 15th level.
items.author: Scribnibbler21

items.name: Blowgun
items.properties:
1 piercing
ammunition, loading
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Boat Oar
items.description: Made for paddling boats, but it was made sturdy enough to fight strong currents. Maybe it's useful for self-defense in a pinch.
items.properties: 1d4 Bludgeoning - Two-Handed
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Bolt of Chaos
items.description: Crossbow bolt of chaos – 1 random effect on hit
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: Bone Crushing Mace
items.description: Bone crushing mace – critical renders limb useless; two handed by any smaller than large

items.name: Bone Darts
items.description: 1d20 normal bone darts. They resemble fletched knitting needles, about 1 foot in length. Not used often by themselves, but rather as ammunition in a blowgun. Can be dipped in poison and used as an effective delivery device.
items.properties: Finesse, Undersized, Thrown (30/60)
items.author: D&D Wiki

items.name: Bone Stylus
items.description: Write the name of your antagonist in your flesh and he will leave you be. Causes one hit point of damage for every letter inscribed in the bearer's flesh. Lasts until the damage is healed.
items.properties: 1d4 Piercing | Finesse, Light

items.name: Bonesaw
items.description: The bonesaw was used to amputate body parts after the skin had already been cut through with the amputation knife.
items.properties: 1d8 Slashing | Finesse
items.author: D&D Wiki

items.name: Boomerang
items.description: This throwing weapon was originally used by forest-dwelling Orcs to hunt game. Its unique shape allows it to return after being thrown.
items.properties:
1d4 Bludgeoning - Thrown (Range: 30/90)
Special: Does not require direct line of sight, due to a curved trajectory. 
If the attack misses, the weapon returns to the thrower's position and can be caught with a free action.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Boomerang of Retrieval
items.description: This otherwise normal looking boomerang has a sense of arcana deep within it's dark oak core. Researching it's history will reveal that this is, in fact, one of many created by a local wizard who was frustrated at being unable to throw a normal boomerang in such a way that it returned naturally.
items.properties:
1d6 Bludgeoning (+1 force damage) - Thrown (Range: 30/90)
Special: Does not require direct line of sight, due to a curved trajectory. 
Unlike a normal boomerang, the boomerang of retrieval will always return to you after you make a ranged attack with it, even if you hit.
items.author: D&D Wiki

items.name: Boomerang Sword
items.description: A curved sword favored by lizardmen. It can be used to attack directly or can be thrown like a boomerang.
items.properties:
1d6 Slashing - Thrown (Range: 30/90)
Special: Does not require direct line of sight, due to a curved trajectory.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Brandistock
items.description: This peculiar spear-like weapon is popular among travelers and law enforcement. The brandistock's three-pronged head is retractable, which renders it indistinguishable from a quarterstaff (unless closely inspected). Extending the blades is instantaneous, but pulling them back requires you to spend an action.
items.properties: 1d8 Piercing, Special, Two-Handed
items.author: D&D Wiki

items.name: Brass Knuckles
items.description: A set of brass knuckles. Used, but in good condition.
items.properties: 1d4 Bludgeoning, Light, Hidden
items.author: D&D Wiki

items.name: Broken Sword
items.description: This is simply a regular sword that has been partially broken, in combat or however. Most people would just get rid of it, but maybe this sword has a nice hilt or sentimental value.
items.properties: 1d4 Piercing, Finesse, Light
items.author: D&D Wiki

items.name: Cestus
items.description: A reinforced gauntlet which protects the knuckles and transforms mere punches into lethal blows. This weapon cannot be disarmed. It takes an action to don or doff a cestus.
items.properties: 1d4 Bludgeoning - Light, Special, Hidden
items.author: D&D Wiki

items.name: Club
items.description: A crude club made to clobber animals and people alike, carved roughly from a thick cedar branch.
items.properties: 1d4 Bludgeoning - Simple - Light
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Combat Boomerang
items.description: This combat boomering does not resembe the conventional "V" shape of a normal boomerang and instead has more of a "tick mark" shape. One end has a smaller wing which is both thicker and carefully reinforced with metal studs. It can be used as both a ranged weapon as expected, but can also be used in close quarters as a club.
items.properties:
1d6 Bludgeoning  - Thrown (Range: 30/90)
Special: Does not require direct line of sight, due to a curved trajectory.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Cowardly Blade

items.name: Net
items.properties:
Thrown

A Large or smaller creature hit by a net is restrained until it is freed. A net has no effect on creatures that are formless, or creatures that are Huge or larger. A creature can use its action to make a DC 10 Strength check, freeing itself or another creature within its reach on a success. Dealing 5 slashing damage to the net (AC 10) also frees the creature without harming it, ending the effect and destroying the net. When you use an action, bonus action, or reaction to attack with a net, you can make only one attack regardless of the number of attacks you can normally make.

items.name: Remnant
items.description: "The handle was made of black leathers which connected two chains down to the head of a cylinder-shaped flail head. The head was like a cage that had interlocking strips of steel with spikes pointing outwards at every link. Inside, it contained a brilliant blue light that hummed which grew with intensity when spun."
items.properties:
You have a + 1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

The Flail Head sheds dim light in a 10-foot radius.

When you roll a 20 on a weapon attack with Remnant, you may conjure forth a frost giant from a mist that flows out from the blue light in the head of this weapon. The creature appears in the same space you are in, using its height to leave the user room to move. If he cannot fit in the space, the creature refuses to be summoned.

After your turn ends, The creature immediately takes it's initiative. The creature hears what commands you have, but acts on it's own and is capable of making it's own decisions. After it's turn is over, the creature remains until the start of your next turn before returning to mist and binding itself to Remnant once more. Once this ability is used, it cannot be used again until you complete a short rest.

items.description: A simple, sturdy longsword with a broad blade. There is a shining sun sigil at the crossguard. The blade shines as if reflecting sunlight, even in the dimmest rooms.
items.properties: 1d8, +1d6 fire, +1d6 radiant. As a bonus action, you may hold the sword above your head, under a clear, bright day in order to charge the sword with power. Doing so increases the fire and radiant damage of the weapon to 2d6 for one minute. The blade also emits a bright light in 60 feet at will.
items.author: /u/gimme_some_sunshine

items.name: Soul Stealer
items.description: A legendary longsword that glows a dark red when a creature dies within 10 feet of the blade.
items.properties:
When this weapon is used to kill an intelligent creature, it's soul is absorbed into the blade. These souls can be released as a bonus action for 1d4 psychic damage per soul. All of the souls must be released at once.
1d12 Slashing - Versatile (2d8)
items.author: William Orfanakos

items.name: Soup Ladel
items.description: A kitchen implement often used for serving delicious soups. It was carved from the wood of a sturdy tree, so it actually packs quite the wallop.
items.properties: 1d4 Bludgeoning - Light
items.author: BOTW

items.name: Spade
items.description: A spade is a simple tool designed for digging soil, the head can be made of any material that can hold its shape, but is most frequently made of metal to facilitate cutting into soil.
items.properties: 1d4 Bludgeoning - Simple
items.author: D&D Wiki

items.name: Spear
items.description: One of man's earliest weapons, dating back to the most primitive of times. A simple wooden pole with a steel spearhead on the end.
items.properties:
1d6 Piercing - Versatile (1d8) 
Thrown: 20/60
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Spear of the Hunter
items.properties:
This spear grants a +2 to AC and summons a friendly wolf whenever a natural 20 is rolled to hit.
1d8 Piercing - Oversized (1d10), Thrown (20/60), Two-Handed
items.author: William Orfanakos

items.name: Spiked Chain
items.description: A length of spiked chain between 6 and 8-feet long with wicked barbs welded onto one end.
items.properties:
1d8 Piercing
Finesse - Heavy - Reach - Two-Handed

If you have the Dual-Wielder feat, the Exotic Weapon Master feat, or the Two-Weapon Fighting style, you can wield a spiked chain as two one-handed, light weapons that each deal 1d6 piercing damage. The spiked chain loses the reach property when wielded in this way.
items.author: PHB

items.name: Spire of the Manticore
items.description:
You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls with this magical weapon, and it deals an additional 1d8 poison damage. The damage increases by 1d8 if the target is a Monstrosity or Beast.

This weapon has 7 spikes hidden within the Barb at the end of the pike. As a ranged attack, you can launch a single spike at a target, each having a range of 100/200 ft. Each of these spikes deal 1d8 piercing damage. Every Morning at dawn, this weapon regrows all of it's spikes.
items.properties: Heavy, Reach, Two-Handed
items.author: Fin Fen

items.name: Staff of the Verdant Grove
items.description: A knotted and well-worn walking stick with living vines that grow from it. There are druidic symbols for everlasting life etched near the handle.
items.properties: 1d6. The vines that grow from the staff will aid the wielder, allowing you to grapple a target with a 10 foot reach, with a +4 bonus. You may also lash a target with the vines, like a whip (you don't need proficiency), dealing 1d6 damage at 10 feet. The staff increases the prosperity of plant life within 25 feet by twenty fold.
items.author: /u/gimme_some_sunshine

items.name: Star of Morning's Glory
items.description: This Morningstar is made of solid wrought steel, with a heavy spiked head. It behaves like a normal Morningstar, except within 60ft of Evil and Undead creatures and within an hour of Dawn. In any of these cases, the head glows like the tip of a Sunrod, and it becomes a Morningstar +2 which stuns for 1d4+1 rnds on a Critical. Fortitude saves vs stun, with a DC equal to the player's attack roll. Cannot be used by Evil creatures.
items.author: /u/LittleDizzleDaGusha

items.name: Stern Sword of Grammar Correction
items.description: A dull, rather drab looking rapier inhabited with the intelligence of a hyper-particular grammarian.
items.properties: Acts as a +1 sword vs any creature speaking with poor grammar construction. On a successful hit, the creature must save or begin using immaculate grammar (spelling gets a bump too), after which the sword attacks the creature as a mundane weapon. Shocks the wielder for 1 hp damage each time he or she uses poor grammar.
items.author: Jeff C

items.name: Sting
items.description: Monster presence detecting weapon (Hobbit – Sting, Orcs/Goblins)

items.name: Sword of Battle Fury
items.description: Battle Fury-grants the feat Cleave

items.name: Sword of Bleeding
items.description: A sharp one-sided blade that is slightly curved.
items.properties: The creature must a Constitution saving throw of 14 or take an addition 1d6. The creature makes this check every turn until succeeded
items.author: Brendan M

items.name: Sword of Frost
items.properties: 1d6 slashing damage, 1d6 chill damage. Freezes/Slows enemies hit, upon death enemy turns to ice and shatters, damaging all nearby enemies for 1d4 chill damage. No effect on fire or ice enemies

items.name: Tactical Defense Stick
items.description: A sturdy wooden stick with two outcropping knobs that look like the crossguards of a sword. Cloth wrappings cover one end to form a more comfortable handle.
items.properties: 1d4 Bludgeoning - Light
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Teakwood Quarterstaff
items.description: An ornately carved quarterstaff of teakwood. The end is carved into the likeness of a dragon’s head, with (painted red) flame issuing from its mouth and the butt end carved into an entwining serpent-like tail. (5gp)
items.author: Unknown

items.name: Terrible Thermometer
items.description: This thermometer has a long, silver blade and a pommeled wooden handle. "Come here, monster! I just want to take your temperature!"
items.properties:
1d6 Piercing
Finesse, Light

This shortsword can be used to tell the temperature of anything it is embedded in.
items.author: Uberbeard

items.name: Thaxton's Hammer
items.description: This warhammer belonged to a famous dwarven general known as Thaxton the Fierce. It grants a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls, as well as Intimidation checks, to the user. If the user is a dwarf, this bonus is increased to +2.
items.author: Scribnibbler21

items.name: The Bloody Burden
items.description: Each day this blade draws no blood it becomes heavier to bear.
items.author: PlatypusPal

items.name: The Guardsman's Friend
items.description: A simple dagger with what seems to be a blood stain on the blade that cannot be washed away. On very close examination, if the leather wrapping of the handle is peeled back the phrase "All Knights are Bad" has been written on the tang.
items.properties:
1d4 Piercing
Finesse - Light - Thrown: 20/60 
As a free action you can put this dagger into another creature's inventory without them noticing.
items.author: OneManBland

items.name: The Harbinger
items.description: An elegant longsword that seems to shift it's appearance to better fit the moral character of it's wielder. A history check will reveal that this longsword was forged by the twins Elda and Essa. After its creation, they used it to cut off each others' hands, ensuring that the world would never see another weapon like it.
items.properties:
1d8+1 Slashing - (Versatile 1d10+1)
